title: VP of People (Remote, US)
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

The Opportunity

Maze is looking for a VP of People to lead our global People function and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive team.

We're at an exciting point in our journey. We've built a strong foundation of People programs and practices, and we're entering a new chapter as we continue to grow our core business while building new opportunities in AI-powered research.

This is an opportunity to shape how we operate, lead, and grow through that evolution. You'll help us make thoughtful decisions about our organization, develop strong leaders, attract and retain great talent, and build a culture where people can do their best work.

We're looking for someone who understands that a great People function is both a strategic business partner and an operationally excellent team. You'll be equally comfortable advising the CEO on organizational strategy, coaching a manager through a difficult conversation, and rolling up your sleeves to solve a problem.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS
description:
EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk.

You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.

  • Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions.

  • Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.

  • Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable.

  • Generate accreditation artifacts — STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings to support ISSM/ISSO requirements in IL4/IL5 environments.

title: Database Programmer
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Database Programmer is responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and archiving of clinical study databases throughout the study lifecycle. This role will play a key part in supporting the deployment, adoption, and ongoing development of Medidata Rave EDC as Alimentiv expands its Electronic Data Capture (EDC) capabilities.

The successful candidate will bring hands-on experience with Medidata Rave EDC and C# programming to develop custom functions, support database configurations, and contribute to clinical database programming activities independently. Working closely with internal project teams and sponsors, this position will help ensure successful database delivery, technical support, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and maintain clinical study databases throughout the study lifecycle.

  • Support the deployment, implementation, and ongoing adoption of Medidata Rave EDC across clinical studies.

  • Develop, program, and test custom functions using C# to support Medidata Rave EDC functionality.

  • Create annotated electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) and program automated edit checks to support data validation.

  • Develop and test files required for electronic data uploads, data transfers, and integrations.

  • Program and generate clinical data listings and project tracking reports to support ongoing studies.

  • Manage database access, process change request (CR) publishing requests, and archive electronic data and documentation upon study completion.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve database programming issues, providing technical expertise and support to internal teams and sponsors.

  • Communicate database setup progress, project milestones, and technical issues to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of database programming processes and departmental procedures.

title: Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)
description:
Role Description

We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would.

This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them.

Responsibilities

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation.
  • Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams.
  • Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.
  • Author and maintain the System Security Plan, policies and procedures, POA&M, and evidence library at the assessment-objective level; score self-assessments and SPRS submissions under the DoD Assessment Methodology and 32 CFR Part 170.
  • Implement the technical controls hands-on in the customer tenant: identity, MFA, and conditional access in Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity; least privilege and privileged-account separation; data protection in Microsoft Purview or Google Workspace DLP; FIPS-validated encryption; configuration baselines. Decide which requirement each setting satisfies and why, and split the heavier build work with the Technical Implementation Engineer.

title: Head of Financial Controller
description:

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
About Withings

Based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Withings designs connected health devices that measure what your body is already saying: smart scales, hybrid smartwatches, blood pressure monitors, sleep analyzers, a connected stethoscope, and Withings+, the service that turns everyday data into a long-term reading of your health. Our products are sold around the world.

The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle.

Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it.

Your Role

As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world.

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.

title: Chef de produit digital F/H
description:
LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA.

Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile. 

Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction.

Le Projet

Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets.

Als kleine Digitalberatung mit Sitz in Lyss bei Bern macht isk consult Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) im Alltag nutzbar. Unsere Mission ist es, KI als konkretes Werkzeug zu etablieren, das Menschen tatsächlich nutzen – nicht als Demo, die nie live geht. Im Praktikum arbeitest du in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit und übernimmst nach der Einarbeitung eigene Teilprojekte. Das Pensum von 40–100% richten wir nach deinem Studium aus.

Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Arbeit ist abwechslungsreich: In einer Woche findest du heraus, welche KI-Lösung zu einem Kunden passt, in der nächsten baust du einen ersten Prototyp oder bereitest einen Workshop vor.

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. This is a chance to get hands-on at the heart of a fast-growing AI hardware company. You'll run a micro-fabrication process flow in our London cleanroom, and the samples you make go straight into the prototypes our engineers are building for the next generation of AI infrastructure.

Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production.

The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand

description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

title: Customer Relations and Warranty Manager
description: Customer Relations and Warranty Manager        You are the person people call when something goes wrong, and the one who quietly makes it right.       This role exists to protect trust once our timber and stone leaves the warehouse. When a defect, a delivery or an installation does not go to plan, you are the one who puts it right.     You will start by owning WOODCUT, our premium engineered timber brand. As that foundation grows stronger, so does your remit, with Signorino next in line.      About Us      Signorino and WOODCUT are both family businesses passed down through the generations, Signorino for more than fifty years & WOODCUT from our director’s grandfather, a timber merchant. Today we supply premium natural stone, terrazzo and porcelain surfaces alongside engineered European oak flooring, specified on many of Australia’s most design-led projects.      The Role      You own the customer experience after the sale, from first call to final fix.      Resolve timber defects and dispatch issues quickly and with care  Manage warranty claims end to end, keeping customers informed at every step  Trace root causes back to transit, warehouse or installation  Hold suppliers and contractors to account while keeping relationships constructive  Coordinate showroom and customer site installations with no last minute surprises  Be the single point of contact for showroom and warehouse teams  Share defect and warranty trends so leadership can make better decisions      You will report into our Operations team, based in Epping, Monday to Friday, with travel across metro, regional and occasionally interstate.      Who We’re Looking For      You stay steady when a customer is frustrated. You know how to turn a hard conversation into a resolved one.      Hands on experience with defects, warranty or after sales  Background in timber, building materials or a related trade  Clear, direct communicator, from phone call to site visit  Keeps the detail straight across teams and locations  Current driver’s licence and comfortable with regular travel      And the non-negotiables: you take ownership when something goes wrong, you keep your word with customers and contractors alike, and you see this role as the start of something bigger.      Values in Practice      These are not aspirational. They are the minimum we expect from everyone here.      Customer Obsessed:  Every single thing we do is for our customers. You understand their needs, exceed expectations, and take initiative to solve problems before they become issues.   One Team:  We achieve great things together. You share your knowledge, offer support and step in when it’s needed.   Make it Count:  We do what we say we’ll do. You hold yourself accountable, prioritise results, and proactively look for ways to improve.   We are Fanatical:  You love what you do. You take pride in where you work, celebrate wins, and bring energy to the people around you.   Be You:  Every voice matters. You treat people

title: Senior Customer Lead
description: Preview  Als Customer Lead ben jij de strategische partner van onze klanten én de verbindende schakel tussen relatiebeheer en delivery. Je zorgt voor duurzame groei door businessdoelen te koppelen aan onze expertise in Marketing, Data Intelligence en Tools & Tech, van onboarding tot uitbreiding.  Wat je gaat doen  Onze klanten zijn uitzendbureaus, detacheerders, recruitmentorganisaties en werkgevers die elke week mensen nodig hebben. Hun vraag is zelden "een campagne" of "een website". Hun vraag is: hoe vullen we onze vacatures sneller, beter en goedkoper? Als Customer Lead ben jij degene die die vraag scherp krijgt en er een plan van maakt.  Small Giants is gespecialiseerd in recruitment, met alle disciplines in huis: branding, conversie, SEO, performance, development, data, tracking en automation. Jij bent de strategische sparringpartner van een vaste set klanten. Je zit aan tafel met marketing-, business unit- en directieniveau, kent hun doelen en vertaalt die naar een aanpak waar onze specialisten mee kunnen vliegen. Je weet waar de kansen liggen, van een ongebruikte leadflow tot SEO-landingspagina's, en je zorgt dat we ze ook pakken.  We bouwen nu aan ons team voor 2027. Dit is dus een kennismaking voor volgend jaar: we leren je graag nu al kennen.   Wat Je Bereikt     De omzet van je klanten blijft behouden en groeit, met klanten die ons zien als partner en niet als leverancier  Elke klant heeft heldere doelen en 3 tot 5 business-KPI's waar we samen op sturen  Elke maand liggen er nieuwe voorstellen klaar, die je samen met de Domain Leads maakt  De marges op je klanten en projecten zijn gezond en voorspelbaar  Klanten zijn tevreden en dat blijkt uit kwartaalreviews, verlengingen en uitbreidingen    Wie jij bent    Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt en strategisch sparringpartner voor meerdere klanten tegelijk  Je leidt onboarding en zorgt voor heldere doelen, scope, KPI's en werkwijze  Je coördineert de samenwerking tussen klant stakeholders, specialisten en domain leads  Je brengt structuur en transparantie in planning, delivery flow, budget en capaciteit  Je signaleert én verzilvert uitbreidingskansen — van idee naar concreet voorstel naar ondertekening  Je herkent scope creep vroeg, voert lastige gesprekken en houdt commerciële afspraken scherp    Wat jij meebrengt    3+ jaar ervaring in een senior klantgerichte, delivery- of projectmatige rol  Aantoonbaar klantrelaties laten groeien in waarde over tijd  Sterk in portfolio management: je weet hoe je prioriteiten stelt als alles urgent lijkt  Je hebt een natuurlijke affiniteit met recruitment business en weet hoe je langdurige, resultaatgerichte samenwerkingen opbouwt in dat domein.  Commercieel instinct: je ziet kansen en sluit ze  Ervaring met contracten, SOW's en scope management  Je navigeert met gemak door complexe stakeholderdynamieken en moeilijke gesprekken  Je bent gewend te werken zonder kant-en-klare playbooks  Ervaring met digitale performance, martech of werken i

title: Head of Customer Success
description: About Us   We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.  As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.   About Energy Systems   We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.   About The Role   The  Head of Customer Success  leads the customer success function within DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, helping internal business customers and the clients they serve turn digital and AI-enabled capabilities into sustained, measurable value. The role sets the customer success strategy and leads a team focused on customer adoption, feature adoption, customer experience, value realization , and growth in adoption.  You will partner with business-group and service-line leaders, regional teams, Global Service Area Leads and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand their priorities and embed useful capabilities into day-to-day work. You will also help ensure that clients understand the value of DNV's digital offerings, experience smooth adoption, and realize benefits quickly. Success means meaningful use that improves business and customer outcomes, not simply access to a platform or completion of a pilot.  Working across global teams and time zones, you will connect customer needs with product, implementation and support teams. You will establish a consistent approach to onboarding, change enablement, customer health and value measurement while allowing for differences in business-group needs and regional ways of working.   This role is based at our DNV office in Toronto, ON and Montreal, QC; offices, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.    What You’ll Do    Customer Success Strategy & Business Partnership     Define and execute the customer success strategy across business groups, service lines and regions, aligning priorities with business outcomes, customer outcomes, and the digital product portfolio.   Build trusted relationships with senior business stakeholders and client facing teams, create joint success plans with priority use cases, adoption milestones and expected benefits.   Establis

You will lead the customer support function, elevating it from a traditional service team into a strategic customer experience capability. title: Customer Success & Onboarding Manager (m/w/d)
description: Apotheken liefern jeden Tag tausende Medikamente direkt zu ihren Kund:innen nach Hause. Dass das reibungslos klappt, mit Tourenplanung, Live-Tracking und Abrechnung, dafür sorgt apomap. Wir sind ein Software-Startup aus Winterberg und machen den Botendienst von Apotheken in ganz Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz digital.  Innovation aus dem Sauerland, nicht aus Berlin. Und genau dafür suchen wir dich.      Was du bei uns machst    Du bringst neue Apotheken an den Start: Einrichtung, Schulung von Team und Fahrer:innen, erste Touren begleiten  Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, per Telefon, Mail und Video-Call  Du merkst, wo es hakt, und gibst Feedback an Produkt und Entwicklung weiter  Du baust Hilfeartikel, Schulungsunterlagen und Abläufe mit auf  Du sorgst dafür, dass Apotheken bei uns bleiben, weil sie gerne mit uns arbeiten       Was du mitbringst    Bock. Ehrlich, das ist uns wichtiger als der perfekte Lebenslauf  Spaß am Umgang mit Menschen und kein Problem damit, auch mal zum Hörer zu greifen  Grundverständnis für Software und Apps, und Lust, Neues schnell zu lernen  Eine strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise  Sehr gutes Deutsch und Lust, regelmäßig bei uns in Winterberg zu sein  Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Support, Apotheke, Handel oder Ähnlichem ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger:innen sind ausdrücklich willkommen       Was wir dir bieten    30 Tage Urlaub  Hybrid: mindestens 3 Tage bei uns im Büro in Winterberg – gern auch öfter, unser Büro ist die ganze Woche offen  Flexible Arbeitszeiten  Firmenlaptop  Weiterbildung, die dich wirklich weiterbringt  Reisekostenübernahme  Kostenlose Getränke und Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür  Dein Haustier darf mit ins Büro  Ein kleines Team, kurze Wege, und deine Arbeit hat direkte Wirkung       Klingt nach dir?   Bewirb dich direkt hier über LinkedIn. Ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist kein Muss. Erzähl uns lieber in zwei, drei Sätzen, warum du Bock auf apomap hast. Start: so bald wie möglich.

title: Commissioning Manager
description: About The Role   As Transition Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing the seamless onboarding of new customers and services into live operational environments. Reporting to the Site Operations Director, you will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of service mobilisation, ensuring that infrastructure, processes, and teams are fully prepared to support contracted service levels from day one. You will lead cross-functional planning and execution across Facilities, Technical Services, Commercial, Compliance, and Security teams, ensuring that all transition activities are aligned with site priorities, customer requirements, and enterprise-wide standards. Your role will include managing mobilisation timelines, risk assessments, documentation, and stakeholder communications to ensure readiness and accountability throughout the transition lifecycle.   Key Responsibilities     Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of customer and service transitions into live operational environments.  Ensure all mobilisation activities, from infrastructure readiness to documentation and team coordination, are delivered to scope, timeline, and quality standards.  Support the seamless integration of new services into the data centre environment, ensuring operational resilience and alignment with site priorities.  Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to maintain 24/7 service continuity during mobilisation phases.  Contribute to OPEX control and CAPEX planning by identifying resource needs, cost impacts, and optimisation opportunities during transition.  Lead risk assessments and incident response planning to embed resilience and accountability into transition programmes.  Use project management tools, dashboards, and performance data to inform decision-making, monitor progress, and identify areas for improvement.     About You   You’re a highly organised, solutions‑driven professional with strong experience coordinating complex service mobilisations or operational transitions. You excel at bringing structure, clarity, and control to fast‑moving environments—aligning teams, processes, and infrastructure to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly and operations are fully prepared from day one.  With a strong understanding of governance, risk management, and stakeholder coordination, you can anticipate issues early, maintain transparent communication, and drive accountability across all functions involved in the transition. Collaborative and confident, you work seamlessly with Facilities, Technical Services, Commercial, Compliance, and Security teams to deliver integrated, resilient solutions. You are proactive, detail‑focused, and calm under pressure, using data, dashboards, and performance metrics to guide decision‑making and continuously improve mobilisation processes. Above all, you take pride in creating seamless customer transitions that strengthen operational excellence and support long‑term business success.   Key Requirement

title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
description:
Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin

Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour.

Your mission with us

  • Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems.

  • Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories.

  • Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach.

  • Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets.

  • Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty.

  • Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour.

  • Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission.

  • Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate.

  • Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages.

  • Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop.

  • Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing.

title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft.

As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
description:
Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make.

  • Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer

  • Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project

  • Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW

  • Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail)

You Will Have Fun If You Are

Builder with agency

  • Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket

  • High ownership: the EMS interface is yours, from the vendor call to go-live

Mission-driven

  • Passionate about energy transition and climate impact

  • Thrive in early-stage chaos (e.g. "Can you be in Ingolstadt tomorrow at 8?")

You Won't Have Fun If You

  • Like to follow processes. We don't have any.

  • Want to work remotely. We're in the office 5 days/week, and regularly on site at customers.

  • Want to stay on one side of the wall. This is half software, half hardware.

title: Technicien·ne confirmé·e ou Ingénieur·e Conception Hardware - Systèmes Embarqués (H/F)
description:
Vos missions

Au sein de notre bureau d’études, en lien direct et quotidien avec la production, vous prenez en charge la conception électronique complète des cartes, de la schématique à l’industrialisation :

  • Analyse du besoin client et définition de l’architecture

  • Choix des composants selon les contraintes (techniques, mécaniques, CEM, industrialisation)

  • Réalisation des schémas et du routage PCB sous Altium Designer

  • Suivi des prototypes, mise au point et validation (essais environnementaux, bancs de test)

  • Industrialisation : programmes de sérigraphie et de pose CMS, dossiers de fabrication, support à l’équipe de fabrication

  • Design to Cost : optimisation des nomenclatures (BOM) et des coûts de revient de produits existants

  • Redesign hardware de produits récurrents, notamment pour traiter les obsolescences de composants

Vos compétences

  • Technicien·ne confirmé·e en CAO électronique ou ingénieur·e avec 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en conception de cartes : les deux profils nous intéressent

  • Maîtrise indispensable d’Altium Designer (schéma + routage)

  • Solides bases en électronique analogique et numérique

  • Expérience du choix de composants, de la gestion de nomenclature et de l’industrialisation

  • Un plus : notions de Solidworks, développement logiciel embarqué (C, microcontrôleurs)

  • Autonomie, rigueur, intérêt pour les produits techniques et compacts

Environnement technique

  • Logiciels : Altium Designer, Solidworks, Git

  • Composants : Microchip, STM32, drivers, convertisseurs, capteurs, modules RF…

  • Contraintes : température, humidité, vibrations, compacité, low energy, CEM

Conditions & Avantages

  • CDI, poste sur site, au plus près de la production : télétravail très limité

title: Freelance French SEO Content Writer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Freelance French SEO Content Writer to strengthen our organic search visibility and AI

search presence across the French markets, including France and French-speaking Africa.

Our current French organic search visibility presents a significant growth opportunity. We are looking for a writer who can

create original, high-quality French content tailored to local audiences, search intent, and SEO best practices. This is a

content-writing role, not a translation role.

The successful candidate will help improve our visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered

answer engines, including ChatGPT and similar platforms.

Key Responsibilities

• Create high-quality French content pieces, based on briefs and keyword targets provided by the SEO team.

• Develop original, engaging and SEO-optimised content for French-speaking audiences in France and Africa.

• Write content aligned with target keywords, search intent, content structure, and on-page SEO requirements.

• Optimise content for traditional search engines as well as AI-powered search and answer engines.

• Research relevant topics, industry trends, competitors, and audience needs to develop authoritative content.

• Adapt and localise existing English-language content for French-speaking markets while ensuring the content reads

naturally and is culturally relevant.

• Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders and make revisions as required.

• Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, content quality, and SEO guidelines.

Types of Content

• Commercial landing pages

• Blogs and thought-leadership articles

• Glossary and definition pages

• Whitepapers and long-form content

• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

• Competitor comparison pages

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Finance Data (FinOps)
description:
About Finom
Finom is growing fast, and Finance needs data that grows with it. As our Lead Analytics Engineer for Finance, you'll be the data partner for treasury, reconciliation and accounting. You'll also support our corporate finance and investor reporting work together with the team's existing data partner. You'll build and scale the data model behind these areas, set standards, integrate the systems Finance relies on and bring in automation, including agents, where it saves real work

This isn't a "build what's in the ticket" role. You'll learn how Finance works and why, understand where the value is, and work with the team on how their processes run, proposing improvements and the data and tools to support them. You'll report to the Head of Central Data

What You Will Be Doing
- Partner with the Treasury, Reconciliation and Accounting teams on their processes, priorities and how data supports them.
- Build out treasury data: positions, cash flows and liquidity, as trusted data products the team can rely on day to day.
- Build and scale reconciliation, so that matching, breaks and exceptions are handled systematically rather than by hand.
- Support Accounting with the data, checks and integrations behind their close and day-to-day work.
- Support our corporate finance data partner on corporate finance and investor reporting, working from one shared model and set of definitions.
- Design and evolve the Finance data model, entities and metrics, with tests, lineage and documentation, so the team can reuse and extend them.
- Set data standards and quality checks for Finance data, and build integrations with the systems Finance uses.
- Bring automation and agents into Finance workflows where they remove recurring manual work.
- Look at how Finance processes run today, identify what can work better and connect each piece of data work to its business cost and value.

title: Advanced Compiler Engineer - Quantum Software
description:
Quantinuum are seeking an Advance Compiler Engineer to join our growing Quantum Software team in Cambridge, UK. In this role, you will help shape the design and implementation of the next generation TKET quantum compiler and contribute to the Guppy quantum programming language. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of software development, compiler design, and quantum computing research.  

You will collaborate closely with a small, dynamic team throughout the full development lifecycle — from research and design to programming and testing — with the freedom to think independently and make a real impact.  

Key Responsibilities 

  • Maintain and contribute to a Rust-based compiler codebase.  
  • Develop and apply optimization methods for quantum-classical programs.  
  • Design and implement novel features for quantum programming languages.  
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders across research and engineering teams.  

You Must Have
  • Software development experience, preferably in Rust or Python.  
  • Broad knowledge of programming languages, paradigms, and compiler concepts.  
  • Ability to work collaboratively, communicate technical ideas clearly, and write clean, maintainable code.  
  • Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., version control, issue tracking) and development tools (e.g., debugger, profiler, testing frameworks).  
  • A 2:1 or higher degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.  
  • Ability to read and implement ideas from technical research materials.  

    • We Value
  • Experience designing classical compilers and programming languages.  
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum algorithms, or programming quantum systems.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

title: Security Architect
description:

AI agents do most of the coding. You bring the judgment: what good looks like at scale, which outcomes matter, and when an agent's output is plausible but wrong. You own what ships and run it in production.

description:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.
Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.

Pourquoi ce recrutement ?
Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas.
Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence.

La technologie développée repose sur des batteries aqueuses utilisant des complexes métalliques. Celles-ci ont la particularité de découpler la puissance délivrée de la quantité d’énergie stockée, grâce notamment à la taille modulable des réservoirs d’électrolyte.

Ironflow Batteries s’appuie sur des matériaux abondants et des complexes métalliques innovants, associés à une membrane performante et à faible coût. Ce positionnement technologique permet d’offrir une solution compétitive pour le stockage stationnaire de l’énergie.

Le stage s’adresse à un profil de niveau Master, issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un master universitaire orienté ingénierie. Il peut s’agir d’un stage de césure comme d’un stage de fin d’études.

Vos missions

En raison de la diversité des compétences mobilisées, un temps d’apprentissage et de montée en compétence sera prévu.

Le profil recherché est celui d’une personne curieuse, adaptable, passionnée par le secteur de l’énergie et attirée par un environnement startup. Des compétences en programmation (Python ou autre) et en conception CAO (Solidworks ou autre) seront un atout apprécié.

title: Senior Scientist — Organoid Model Development
description:
Job description

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them — and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

We are looking for a passionate, hands-on Senior Scientist to expand Orakl's biobank to new indications. Working with significant autonomy and reporting to Gizem Altay, Principal Scientist, you will own the establishment of patient-derived organoids from fresh surgical specimens — starting with NSCLC and extending to additional tumour types — from tissue receipt and dissociation through to stable, well-characterised lines ready for downstream applications. You will develop and optimise robust culture protocols, ensure reproducibility across donors, and generate the high-quality biological models that power our AI predictive engine and our partnerships with hospitals and pharma.

Preferred experience

Must have

  • PhD in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biol

title: TCS and ECLSS Certification Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Mission

We are developing, manufacturing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable spacecraft which will carry cargo to space stations and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced Certification Engineer to join our Thermal Control System & Environmental Control and Life Support System team. You will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and driving the certification and verification closure activities of the Nyx Thermal Control System (TCS) and Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) in support of vehicle qualification, NASA certification, and flight acceptance.

The role serves as the primary focal point between the TCS & ECLSS teams, System Engineering, Verification & Validation, Chief Engineering Office, AIT, Program, Safety Engineering, and external stakeholders. The Certification Engineer ensures that TCS and ECLSS requirements are properly allocated, verified, traceable, and closed with appropriate evidence, while maintaining alignment with NASA SSP requirements, Data Item Deliverables (DIDs), verification plans, and Safety Review Panel expectations.

The position requires a strong understanding of spacecraft systems engineering, thermal engineering, verification methodologies, qualification logic, and agency review processes to ensure that technical evidence across both subsystems is complete, credible, traceable, and accepted by the certification authorities.

Lead Thermal & ECLSS Verification Closure Activities

title: Model Risk Officer
description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

title: Talent & People Lead (m/f/d)
description:
About VIA HealthTech

VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. That is work which used to cost therapists hours every week.

We are the market leading AI assistant for psychotherapists. Over 4,000 psychotherapists across the DACH region use VIA every day, and we process hundreds of thousands of sessions per month. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and hold a BSI C5 attestation.

We are a multidisciplinary team of 12 in Berlin-Mitte. Being the market leader in AI documentation is our starting position, not our goal. We are going much deeper, into the therapeutic process itself and into how a practice is run, with products that will be regulated as medical devices under EU MDR.

The role

We are 12 today and plan to roughly double in the next year, across engineering, our clinical team and go-to-market. We are bootstrapped. YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

title: Agent Security Engineer
description:
Belmont Lavan is hiring an Agent Security Engineer to secure autonomous AI agents before and after they reach production. Agents now call tools, hold credentials and act on live systems, so they need the controls we already expect for people and services: identity, least-privilege access, monitoring and testing.

You will sit between AI engineering and security. You will design the guardrails, attack the systems yourself, and build the governance controls that let the business deploy agents with confidence.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in security engineering (AppSec, cloud security, IAM or offensive security), with at least 1 year securing LLM or agent-based systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of LLM attack techniques: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration via tools, RAG poisoning
  • Experience designing identity and access controls: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, token exchange, workload identity, secrets management
  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Strong coding skills in Python, plus one of Go, TypeScript or Rust
  • Cloud security on AWS, Azure or GCP, including logging, detection and policy-as-code (e.g. OPA / Cedar)
  • Ability to explain AI risk clearly to engineers, risk teams and executives

title: Senior Executive Assistant (PSA-3)

United Nations University (UNU)

The United Nations University (UNU) is a global think tank and postgraduate teaching organization within the United Nations System. UNU engages in policy-relevant research, capacity development, and knowledge dissemination in furtherance of the purposes and principles of the United Nations. The work of UNU contributes to solving pressing global problems that are the concern of the United Nations and its Member States. 

For the past five decades, UNU has been a source of impartial research on sustainability, human security, and economic development. With hundreds of researchers working at institutes in 12 countries, UNU's expertise spans the full breadth of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, generating policy-relevant knowledge to effect positive global change. UNU collaborates closely with other UN entities and leading research institutions across the globe. For more information, please visit http://unu.edu.

The United Nations University Vice-Rectorate in Europe (UNU-VIE), established in 2007 in Bonn, Germany, is one of two UNU Vice-Rectorates and the only one located in Europe. It supports the institutional development of UNU, facilitates collaboration across UNU and the UN, as well as fosters strategic partnerships - particularly with the Global South - and shares knowledge and expertise through the development of joint activities and projects. In addition, UNU-VIE conducts frontier research reinforcing existing UNU programming and supporting the implementation of key UN priorities. More information about UNU-VIE can be found here: https://unu.edu/vie.

description:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Dein PEPP-Wissen: nicht für eine Klinik, sondern für viele. Du kennst die DKR-Psych im Detail, weißt, wo im Klinikalltag Erlöse verloren gehen, und hast schon mit dem MD über Fälle diskutiert? Bei Valova sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere KI so gut kodiert wie Du, und bringst sie in psychiatrische und psychosomatische Kliniken in ganz Deutschland.

Die Kodierung in Psychiatrie und Psychosomatik folgt eigenen Regeln. Therapieeinheiten, ergänzende Tagesentgelte, Fallzusammenführungen und Personalvorgaben machen PEPP zu einem der anspruchsvollsten Systeme im Krankenhaus, und jede Lücke in Dokumentation oder Kodierung kostet Erlöse und führt zu MD-Prüfungen. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software PEPP so gut versteht wie die besten Kodierfachkräfte. Genau dafür brauchen wir Dich.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in Fällen, die vollständig kodiert sind und in der Prüfung bestehen, in weniger Streit mit dem MD und in Stunden, die Kodierteams und Therapeut:innen zurückgewinnen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova PEPP beibringen: Du übersetzt ICD-10-GM, OPS Kapitel 9, DKR-Psych, PEPP-Katalog und PsychPV/PPP-RL in klare Kodierregeln, Plausibilitätsprüfungen und Testfälle, inklusive Therapieeinheiten, ergänzender Tagesentgelte und Fallzusammenführungen.

  • KI-Vorschläge prüfen: Du bewertest die Kodiervorschläge von Valova und markierst, was stimmt und was nicht. So wird die Qualität messbar besser.

title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

title: Founding Business Development Representative
description:
TL;DR

We're hiring a Founding BDR to build Lovable's business development motion from the ground up. The job is to find, qualify and open the right accounts using a mix of your own outreach and the automation and AI agents you build to run alongside it. You'll own a pipeline number, work closely with our Account Executives globally and build a lot of your own tooling on Lovable itself. This is also how we develop AEs: perform here and you'll be running your own deals within 12 to 18 months. There's no playbook yet, so you'll be helping to write it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognised on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The role:

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a senior member of the Paddle legal and compliance team, reporting directly to Paddle’s Director of Legal. The Paddle legal team is well-respected and integrated into Paddle’s business. As a result, this role will require you to collaborate with other teams across the business, and advise cross-functionally, always with a view to empowering the business to achieve its goals while taking a long-term strategic view.

The role itself will be broad and varied, with a core regulatory element. You will be delivering first-rate legal advice in a fast-paced dynamic environment, identifying risk and balancing common sense with your legal expertise. You will be an excellent generalist, comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity.

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will consider the longer-term impacts whilst also being able to react quickly to deliver level-headed, creative and context-appropriate solutions to ensure the best possible customer experience in the ever changing tech space.

The role will be based in the UK but will be global in scope.

About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.

That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: Cove is the operating entity for Deck2 Capital. Together, we acquire and operate good businesses with untapped potential and make them exceptional. We do this by taking majority positions in digital companies that distribute insurance. Cove then applies a shared platform of technology, data, talent, and playbooks to each business we acquire.       You'll own lifecycle marketing across Cove's portfolio, starting with Auto Europe — every email, push and on-site message a customer gets between their first visit and their next booking. Car rental is a promo-driven, seasonal, high-intent category: the right offer to the right traveller at the right moment is how we can continue to build a sustainable business.     This is an operator's role. You'll run the promo calendar, ship campaigns and journeys every week, and build the lifecycle playbook we roll out to each new business Cove acquires. You're accountable for lifecycle-driven NCI, not opens and clicks. You'll work alongside the Growth Engineer, who builds the automation and data plumbing, and report into Growth.      This role is based in our   harbourfront Manly office  , across the road from the Ferry terminal for easy commutes. We're a hybrid workplace and ask that the team works in-person 2-3 days per week.        What you'll do         Own the promotional calendar:  Plan and ship the always-on cadence of sales, seasonal pushes and partner promos across markets, languages and brands. You decide what goes out, to whom, and when.   Build and run lifecycle journeys:  Welcome, quote and booking abandonment, pre-trip, post-trip, win-back and repeat-rental — in Iterable, and keep improving them.   Drive repeat and ancillary revenue:  Use lifecycle to lift rebooking rates and protection/extras attach, not just send volume.   Run disciplined experiments:  Offer depth, timing, subject lines, creative, segments — with holdouts, so we know what's incremental and what's just discounting customers who'd book anyway.   Protect margin and the list:  Manage promo fatigue, frequency, deliverability and consent across markets (GDPR and local rules).   Segment and personalise:  By source market, destination, booking window, value and behaviour, using the data we have rather than waiting for perfect data.   Automate the grind:  Work with the Growth Engineer to turn manual production (briefs, translations, QA, reporting) into LLM-assisted workflows so a small team ships like a big one.   Build the playbook that scales:  Stand up lifecycle at each new acquisition fast, using what's worked at Auto Europe.   Report clearly:  Own lifecycle performance (NCI, repeat rate, revenue per send, unsubscribe and complaint rates) and share it with commercial and leadership.       What you bring:         You've run consumer lifecycle for a promo-heavy business:  Retail, e-commerce, travel, food delivery or similar, where the promo calendar drives a big share of revenue. Grow yourself personally and professionally with a company that’s growing with you, through global expansion and product offering. You’ll play an important role in developing your team, improving client experiences and delivering strong service outcomes across CMC Markets and our white-label partners. title: Investments Client Operations Senior Manager
description: We are seeking a talented individual to join our Operations team at Marsh Investments International. This role will be based in Dublin and offers an exciting opportunity to join one of Marsh's largest and fastest-growing business areas — delegated investment solutions.  Marsh is one of the leading and most rapidly growing investment solutions businesses globally, with a continually expanding client base and strong momentum for continued growth.  The Operations team is responsible for the onboarding of new clients, launching new funds, client and fund rebalancing, oversight of underlying investment manager changes, NAV and valuation oversight, fund expenses, regulatory and tax oversight, management of third-party service providers, operational infrastructure changes, and the development and maintenance of relationships with internal and external stakeholders, all within a strong risk and control environment.  This is a hybrid role with a requirement to work at least three days per week in the Dublin office.   Role purpose:   The Client Operations Senior Manager will report to the Deputy Head of Operations and play a key role within the Investment Solutions Public Operations team.  The role will have a broad remit across the department, with a particular focus on providing dedicated operational support to a portfolio of top-tier clients, including third-party management companies (Mancos). These clients may require a more tailored and hands-on service model due to their size, scale, complexity, and volume of change activity. The role will act as a central coordination point for these clients, advocating for them internally, tracking deliverables, and ensuring commitments are met in a timely and professional manner.  A key part of the role is to deliver an exceptional client experience — one that is proactive, responsive, and highly attentive to client needs — so that clients feel valued, supported, and well serviced across all operational touchpoints.  In addition, the role will provide general operational support across the department as required, including responding to requests from the COO, Head of Operations, or Deputy Head of Operations, and supporting wider priorities, change activity, and business-critical initiatives as needed.   We will rely on you to:      Act as a trusted operational partner for assigned top-tier client relationships, building strong, credible relationships with client-side contacts and internal stakeholders.    Provide dedicated support to complex and strategic client relationships, ensuring service delivery is aligned to client expectations and business objectives.    Serve as the key internal advocate and coordinator for assigned clients, ensuring actions, deliverables, dependencies, and timelines are clearly tracked and progressed.    Proactively manage client operational requests, queries, and issues, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional communication at all stages.    Deliver an above-and-beyond
