title: Service Manager
description: Over het bedrijf      Bakker Sliedrecht is al meer dan 100 jaar een systeemintegrator voor elektrische aandrijf-, energie- en automatiseringssystemen. Het bedrijf werkt in de maritieme sector, de industrie en de duurzame energie, en is onderdeel van VINCI Energies. Het is een nuchtere, technisch sterke organisatie: doe maar normaal, laat zien wat je doet en werk hard met elkaar.      Over de functie      Bakker Sliedrecht zoekt een  Service Manager  die van een groep vakmensen een sterk serviceteam maakt. Je werkt binnen de Business Unit Energy Solutions. Daar werken ongeveer vijftien collega’s, en de helft daarvan doet service aan energiesystemen zoals windenergie, energieopwekking en walstroom. De opdracht is concreet: binnen een jaar staat er een team dat samenwerkt, zijn de belangrijkste serviceprocessen ingericht en krijgen klanten voorspelbare communicatie en opvolging. Wil je bouwen aan mensen, processen en duurzame klantrelaties in een technisch sterke organisatie? Neem dan contact op met Tim van Mind Your Head Recruitment. Hij vertelt je graag meer. Je kunt ook direct solliciteren via de knop op deze pagina. Startdatum uiterlijk 1 januari 2027.      📧 Tim@mindyourheadrecruitment.nl

You'll be the primary client-facing CSM and the single point of operational accountability across the account operations function. You'll make sure the right work is being done by the right people, at the right quality, at the right time - while staying close enough to execution to step in when capacity gaps, escalations, or complex account issues require hands-on support.  This role suits someone who combines strong Amazon expertise with excellent client management, leadership, and operational discipline. You should be comfortable making decisions independently, managing multiple priorities, developing people, and taking ownership of client outcomes without needing constant CEO involvement. With steady organic growth and a small, expert team, this is a strong opportunity to take ownership of a critical leadership function and help build a highly efficient, scalable account operations department. title: Manager of Customer Success, Activation
description: Join Our Team at RealWork      We’re  RealWork , a team of builders and problem-solvers based in Austin, TX. Our mission is to help home service professionals earn the trust they deserve online.      RealWork  is the marketing engine behind thousands of contractors nationwide. We transform their best jobs into SEO-optimized stories, photos, and reviews that drive growth. Through integrations with leading field service platforms, we automate meaningful customer engagement after each job and use job content to help contractor’s online presence better reflect the quality of their work in the field.      RealWork  is based 100% in the USA and headquartered in Austin, TX.      The Role   The first 90 days decide whether a new customer sticks with RealWork. Our Activation team owns that window: onboarding new accounts, getting them set up and using the product, and handling inbound calls and emails along the way.     As Manager, you will lead this team and own its results on activation and early retention. This is a player-coach role: most of your time goes to coaching and developing the team and improving how we onboard customers, and you will step in on customer calls and escalations when needed. This is a full-time role based in our Austin office, five days a week.      What you'll do    Lead and coach the team    Manage daily operations, including workload, scheduling and call coverage, and run one-on-ones and team meetings.  Hire, onboard and train Activation Specialists, and maintain training materials and process documentation.  Review live and recorded Zoom meetings, calls and emails, audit account work against our process standards, and give specialists specific feedback.  Act as the escalation point for complex customer issues, and cover calls for specialists who are out.    Own performance    Track team and individual KPIs, including activation rate, early churn, product adoption and call activity.  Report on trends, root causes and actions to Customer Success leadership.  Use data to find at-risk accounts early and make sure the team acts on them.    Improve the process, including with AI    Find friction in onboarding, test fixes and measure whether they worked.  Build AI-assisted workflows and automations for repetitive work such as call notes, follow-up emails, account research and reporting, and coach the team to use these tools well. Prior experience building automations isn't required, but getting better with these tools is a core expectation of the role.    Partner across the company    Give Sales structured feedback on handoff quality and patterns in accounts that struggle to activate.  Bring product feedback, bugs and feature requests from new customers to Product and Engineering.  Work with Implementation, Support & Retention so customers move smoothly from onboarding into their long-term relationship with RealWork.       What you bring    At least 1 year of experience managing people as a manager, supervisor or team lead.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About Kustomer

Kustomer is the AI-native customer experience platform that turns every interaction into a lasting relationship and a measurable business outcome. By unifying customer data, conversations and AI-native workflows into a single connected timeline, Kustomer helps teams cultivate customers, not tickets, resolving issues faster and delivering more personalized service across every channel. Today, Kustomer is the core platform for leading customer service brands like Sweetgreen, Starz, Vuori, Goldbelly and Cotopaxi.

Founded in 2015 by serial entrepreneurs Brad Birnbaum and Jeremy Suriel, Kustomer raised nearly $200M in funding culminating in a Series E before being acquired by Meta in a deal that closed in 2022. In 2023, Kustomer's founders and original investors, Battery, Redpoint, and Boldstart Ventures, spun the company back out with a $60M investment as an independent, privately held business ready to focus more deeply on AI. In 2025, Norwest led our Series B, bringing our total funding to $90M. This momentum allowed Kustomer to double down on AI-native innovation and build a sharper roadmap for the future of customer experience. Our Krew is a remote-friendly team spread across the U.S. with hubs in NYC and London. We gather in person each year at our annual Kustomer Kick-Off event and always look for Krew members who are curious, collaborative, and ready to shape the future of Customer Experience.

About the Role
Kustomer’s AI agent resolves routine questions, and our support partners handle the next layer of straightforward requests. This role handles what’s left: complex, ambiguous technical issues across webhooks, APIs, workflows, integrations, and AI agent behavior. You’ll be the final escalation point before Engineering. You’ll also make Tier 1 and 2 stronger by turning each hard case into a runbook, a fix, or a product improvement.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Owning technical issues end to end, from reproduction through root cause and resolution, within defined SLAs

  • Diagnosing failures in webhooks, REST API integrations, workflows, and automations using logs, payloads, and developer tools

  • Troubleshooting AI agent behavior, such as misrouted or incorrect resolutions, knowledge gaps, and failed actions or integrations, and recommending configuration or knowledge fixes

  • Escalating to Engineering with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, and following through to resolution

  • Identifying recurring issue patterns and partnering with Product and Engineering on fixes, tooling, and self-service improvements

  • Writing runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and escalation playbooks for our AI agent and BPO partners

  • Coaching and enabling Tier 1/2 and BP

Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (Japanese speaker)
description:
The role of an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a fairly new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customer’s objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap. 

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, in their native language and with excellent English for any internal interaction, CSMs are specialized in one of the following motions:

  • Mass - small and medium businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - strategic and Enterprise customers

title: Golang Engineering Manager, Commercial Systems
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Golang Engineering Manager, who strives for accountability for the development of an internal product, who has high engineering quality standards, continuously develops their skills as well as skills of their direct reports, and who has the drive to deliver. This is an exciting opportunity to work with great people and exciting open-source solutions on innovative engineering solutions supporting Canonical's growth.

The Commercial Systems unit is conceived as six engineering teams that closely collaborate with other engineering and business teams at Canonical. Services designed, developed, and operated by the Commercial Systems unit are at the heart of Canonical business and Golang plays an integral role in it. We are looking for software engineering managers for these teams:

The Billing team designs, develops, and operates a Golang service that provides a standardized and scalable capability to turn metrics into billable amounts, enable customers to see their current spend with Canonical at any time, and ensure accurate, reliable, and timely billing. The service further integrates with other engineering, business, payment systems. This team is an excellent match for those interested in growing their skills in the billing and payment processing domain.

The Livepatch team designs and develops a service for the delivery of Linux kernel patches to shrink the exploit window for critical and high severity Linux kernel vulnerabilities, by patching the Linux kernel between security maintenance windows, while the system runs. The engineering team behind this product develops Golang based client and backend components, while another Canonical team, the Kernel team, develops the security patches. This team is a great opportunity for those interested in security and with a strong focus on engineering quality and reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Accountability for the design and development of an internal product
  • Leading a team of software engineers

title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure - Kafka
description:
Canonical is building a comprehensive automation suite to provide multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. The data platform team is a collaborative team that develops a managed solutions for a full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, through NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines (similar to Amazon RDS approach). 

We are facing the interesting problem of fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems and intend to deliver the world's best automation solution for delivering managed data platforms. 

We are looking for candidates from junior to senior level with interests, experience and willingness to learn around Big Data technologies, such as distributed event-stores (Kafka) and parallel computing frameworks (Spark). Engineers who thrive at Canonical are mindful of open-source community dynamics and equally aware of the needs of large, innovative organisations.

Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East and African time zones.

What your day will look like

The data platform team is responsible for the automation of data platform operations, with the mission of managing and integrating Big Data platforms at scale. This includes ensuring fault-tolerant replication, TLS, installation, backups and much more; but also provides domain-specific expertise on the actual data system to other teams within Canonical. This role is focused on the creation and automation of infrastructure features of data platforms, not analysing and/or processing the data in them.

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high-quality, idiomatic Python code to create new features
  • Debug issues and interact with upstream communities publicly
  • Work with helpful and talented engineers including experts in many fields
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development using Python
  • Proven hands-on experience in distributed systems, such as Kafka and Spark
  • Have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM, or a similar degree
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

You might also bring a subset of experience from the followings that can help Data Platform to achieve its challenging goals and determine the level we will consider you for:

  • Experience operating and managing other data platform technologies, SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, ElasticSearch, etc), similar to DBA level expertise

We are hiring a software architect for Canonical LXD and MicroCloud.

Our goal is to make clusters of compute, with system containers or virtual machines, "just work". It should be trivial to stand up a small cloud using one, two or twenty servers. As a software architect, you will drive the architecture, design and evolution of LXD, and also Canonical MicroCloud which combines LXD with Ceph and OVN to make a lean, easy to use and resilient cluster-scale cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for an outstanding software architect and engineer with experience in Golang and C, with the leadership qualities needed to rally a team to ship outstanding products. Knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure offerings, their APIs and their underlying technologies is a must.

title: Customer Success Internship (German speaking)
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field

  • Proficiency with scripting languages like Python and Bash
  • Extensive experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), specifically FreeRTOS
  • Familiarity with serial protocols and implementations

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager (f/m/d).
description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

Oletko valmis astumaan palvelupäällikön rooliin dynaamisessa siivouksen toimialan ympäristössä? Tunnistatko itsestäsi ammattimaista intohimoa monipuoliseen tehtäväkenttään ja olet valmis viemään esihenkilönä tiimimme uudelle tasolle? Kehittyvä RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa ammattilaisilleen mahdollisuudet ammatilliseen kehitykseen. Kasvun myötä on meille avautunut paikka johtamistaitoiselle ja kokonaisuudet hallitsevalle  PALVELUPÄÄLLIKÖLLE! Toimit tiimisi esihenkilönä ohjaten vastuualueesi tuloksellista toimintaa. Olet joukkuehenkinen ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, suomen ja englannin kielen taito on tehtävässä välttämätöntä. Kykysi ylläpitää ja vahvistaa asiakassuhteita on tärkeää menestymisellemme.Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, yhteistyökykyä ja sosiaalisuutta: on tärkeää, että osaat ja aidosti haluat innostaa henkilöstöä. Arvostamme pitkää kokemusta siivouksen toimialan esihenkilötehtävistä ja siivousalan esihenkilötutkintoa. Työsi on jatkuvaa kehittämistä. Olet innostunut työstäsi ja valmis kehittämään niin omaa kuin tiimisi työtä. Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja olemme valmiita auttamaan toinen toisiamme. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.Kannat vastuun omasta tekemisestäsi ja vastavuoroisesti annamme sinulle vapauden työskennellä itsenäisesti. Työ on luonteeltaan liikkuvaa, joten edellytämme sinulta ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksesi.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. title: Serviceansvarig, Ingå närhälsostation, Ingå
description: Vill du leda, utveckla och skapa framtidens vård nära invånarna i Ingå och Sjundeå? Vi söker en engagerad, utvecklingsinriktad och inspirerande serviceansvarig till Ingå närhälsostation med start den 1.12.2026.  Vi söker en engagerad, utvecklingsinriktad och inspirerande serviceansvarig till Ingå närhälsostation från 1.12.2026. Uppdraget gäller inledningsvis Ingå närhälsostation och utvidgas vid årsskiftet till att även omfatta Sjundeå närhälsostation. Du får en central roll i att leda verksamheten och utveckla närservicen. Genom ett närvarande och engagerande ledarskap främjar du en arbetskultur där samarbete, delaktighet, kvalitet samt klient- och patientsäkerhet står i centrum.  Som medlem i hälsostationernas ledningsgrupp bidrar du till det mångprofessionella utvecklingsarbetet och är med och formar framtidens tjänster för invånarna.  Behörighetskrav: Vi söker dig som är legitimerad yrkesutbildad person inom hälso- och sjukvården och har en lämplig högskoleexamen eller tidigare institutsexamen. Du behärskar svenska och finska i tal och skrift och har goda IT-kunskaper.  Vi värdesätter särskilt erfarenhet av chefs- eller ledarskapsuppdrag, primärvården, mottagningsverksamhet, verksamhetsutveckling och förändringsledning. Kunskap om kvalitetsarbete samt klient- och patientsäkerhet är meriterande. Som person är du lösningsorienterad och engagerande och bidrar till en positiv och inkluderande arbetsgemenskap.  För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara stresstålig, kunna se större helheter och samtidigt hantera detaljer med noggrannhet. Du omsätter planer i praktiken, fattar beslut med trygghet och driver arbetet framåt även när tempot är högt.  Vi uppskattar att du är flexibel, tar ansvar och möter verksamhetens behov med ett nytänkande och utvecklingsinriktat arbetssätt. title: IT Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description: Dein neuer Arbeitgeber ist in der IT- und Digitalisierungsberatung tätig. Wir sind darauf spezialisiert, Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich mit den richtigen Unternehmen zu verbinden. Wenn du mehr über das Unternehmen und die Stelle erfahren möchtest, dann bewirb dich jetzt auf die Stelle.   Rolle   Unser Kunde ist eine grössere Organisation im semi-öffentlichen Umfeld mit einer vielseitigen IT-Landschaft und hohen Anforderungen an die Servicequalität. In dieser interimistischen Leitungsfunktion übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb zentraler IT-Services und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen internen Teams und externen Providern weiter. Du schaffst verbindliche Abläufe für Support und Störungsbearbeitung, etablierst ein transparentes Kennzahlensystem und stärkst die Serviceorientierung der Organisation. Mit deiner Führungserfahrung sorgst du für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und verlässliche Betriebsprozesse.   Verantwortung     Personelle und fachliche Leitung eines IT-Service-Teams mit fünf bis sieben Mitarbeitenden  Sicherstellung des Betriebs von ERP- und CRM-Anwendungen, Power BI sowie Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Exchange  Verantwortung für Providersteuerung, Service-Level-Agreements und Eskalationen  Konzeption und Einführung eines zentralen Anlaufpunkts für IT-Anfragen mit Jira  Optimierung von Incident-, Request- und Supportmanagement sowie Aufbau einer strukturierten CMDB  Erarbeitung und Präsentation von Servicekennzahlen, Risiken und Qualitätsberichten  Sicherstellung nachvollziehbarer Betriebsprozesse und Einhaltung von Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsvorgaben     Qualifikationen     Abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation  Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer leitenden Funktion im IT-Service-Management  Sehr gute Kenntnisse von ITIL und serviceorientierten Betriebsmodellen  Praxis in der Steuerung externer Provider und im Management ausgelagerter IT-Leistungen  Gutes technisches Verständnis von Cloud-Services und unternehmensweiten Applikationen  Grundlegende Kenntnisse in IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz  Klare, strukturierte Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kunden- und Serviceorientierung     ROCKEN Jobs   https://rocken.jobs   Profil Erstellen   https://rocken.jobs/application/profil-erstellen/

title: BESS Service Manager
description: Job Description: BESS Service Manager    1. Basic Job Information    Job Title : BESS O&M Service Manager   Department : Europe Service Management Dept.   Report To : Europe Service Director    Work Location : Europe (Hybrid)    Vacancy : 2      Job Attribute : Core management role, dedicated to Utility-scale and C&I ESS, responsible for full-cycle service project execution, revenue, profitability, quality and customer satisfaction.      2. Job Overview   Support to build up the service system across Europe, manage E2E after-sales service.  Front-End Sales Support: Support service sales activities; strictly control service scope, SLAs, risks and LD to ensure seamless service deliverability.  Back-End Operations: Take over Warranty and LTSA projects handover to O&M; oversee all service activities during O&M phase, present service values, ensuring O&M service quality and customer experience.  Lead to design and deploy O&M service processes and intelligent tool platforms.      3. Core Job Responsibilities    3.1 Full-Cycle Project Performance & O&M Management   Lead the service team, take full responsibility for the performance of new and existing LTSA projects, and oversee the full lifecycle O&M services after grid connection. Strictly implement contractual service standards, track core KPIs such as power station availability, system performance and fault repair timeliness, regularly deliver project performance reports and performance analysis reports, and ensure 100% compliant project performance to meet owner and grid assessment requirements.   3.2 Resource & Spare Parts System Management   Plan and implement a centralized, remote plus localized O&M model, manage own team and outsourced service providers across Europe, and standardize remote and on-site operating procedures, safety specifications and service standards.   Establish a complete mechanism for spare parts warehousing, allocation, replacement and inventory checking. Accurately predict spare parts demand, control spare parts costs and logistics efficiency, solve on-site problems such as parts shortage, replacement and rework, ensure stable operation of power stations, and effectively reduce downtime and operation losses.   3.3 Fault Disposal & Technical Optimization   Lead the disposal of major and complex faults of ESS projects, identify root causes, formulate rectification plans, preventive mechanisms and optimization strategies, and summarize standardized solutions through case review. Based on power station operating data, battery attenuation rules and system operating problems, collaborate with R&D, engineering and quality teams to promote product iteration, program upgrade, structural optimization and O&M process improvement, so as to continuously enhance the stability, safety and service life of energy storage power stations and optimize long-term project operation quality.   3.4 Customer Relationship & Satisfaction

title: SAP FI Service Manager - Pubblica Amministrazione
description: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una  SAP FI Service Manager - Progetto Pubblica Amministrazione    Il Tuo Contributo In Questo Ruolo   La persona si occuperà di coordinare e governare servizi e progetti SAP rivolti a clienti della Pubblica Amministrazione, garantendo il corretto presidio delle attività progettuali, il rispetto degli SLA e la gestione delle relazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.  Sarà responsabile del coordinamento dei team di lavoro, della pianificazione delle attività e del monitoraggio delle performance del servizio, contribuendo all'evoluzione e all'ottimizzazione delle soluzioni SAP adottate dai clienti.   Il Profilo Ideale   La persona ideale ha maturato almeno  8 anni  di esperienza nella gestione di servizi e progetti SAP in contesti complessi della Pubblica Amministrazione, con una solida conoscenza dei processi amministrativi e gestionali tipici del settore pubblico.  È gradita la conoscenza di almeno un modulo SAP in ambito Finance (FI, CO, FM o equivalenti).   Si Richiedono      Esperienza nella gestione di servizi e progetti SAP presso clienti della Pubblica Amministrazione   Esperienza nel coordinamento di team multidisciplinari e nel governo di fornitori e stakeholder   Conoscenza dei processi amministrativi della PA, con particolare riferimento alla gestione di contratti, ordini, clienti, fornitori e subappalti   Gradita conoscenza di almeno un modulo SAP in ambito Finance   Capacità di presidiare attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e reporting progettuale   Autonomia organizzativa e capacità di gestione delle priorità   Approccio consulenziale e ottime capacità relazionali verso il cliente   Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, parlata e scritta   Ottime capacità analitiche, orientamento al risultato e problem solving   Flessibilità e attitudine al lavoro in contesti complessi e strutturati      Sede di lavoro:  Milano, Roma, Napoli   Costruisci il tuo futuro con NTT DATA.   Entra a far parte di un’azienda globale, leader nei servizi di business e tecnologici, che ascolta la tua voce e riconosce il valore del tuo lavoro. Collaborerai con clienti, partner e colleghi di tutto il mondo per creare soluzioni innovative capaci di avere un impatto reale sulla società. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network.  Siamo presenti in Italia con oltre 6000 dipendenti a Milano, Roma, Torino, Genova, Bologna, Treviso, Pisa, Padova, Napoli, Cosenza, Bari e Salerno.   Make this the place where you grow.    Unisciti a noi!

title: Centre Manager | Business Centre Operations & Client Relations – Central Tokyo
description: Centre Manager | Business Centre Operations & Client Relations – Central Tokyo   Our client is seeking a Centre Manager to oversee daily operations, client relationships, and team performance at a premium flexible workspace in Central Tokyo. The role combines hospitality-level customer service, commercial responsibilities, and team leadership. Candidates from luxury hospitality or premium retail backgrounds are particularly suited to this opportunity, which offers a Monday-to-Friday schedule without evening or weekend work and career development within a global organisation.   主な責任 :    ビジネスセンターの日常業務全般を統括し、顧客や来訪者にとって快適でプロフェッショナルな環境を維持する。  フロントデスク業務を管理し、会員に対して質の高いサービスを提供する。  個人会員および法人顧客との良好な関係を構築し、継続的な信頼関係を維持する。  少人数のチームを指導・育成・サポートし、サービス品質と運営水準の向上を図る。  会議室の予約管理、ケータリングの手配、特別イベントの運営調整を行う。  アップセルやクロスセルの機会を見極め、センターの売上拡大につなげる。  顧客からの意見、問い合わせ、クレームに対して、迅速かつ適切に対応する。  施設の外観・内装やサービス品質を管理し、会社が定める高い運営基準を維持する。  オフィスの稼働率向上と既存顧客の維持を通じて、センターの収益目標達成を支援する。  顧客からの各種依頼やサービスに関する問い合わせの主要窓口として対応する。  自ら率先してチームをリードし、前向きで顧客サービスを重視する職場環境をつくる。  事業開発部門や運営チームと連携し、センター全体の業績と運営効率の改善を進める。  郵便物、宅配便、各種ビジネスサポートサービスを管理し、顧客の業務を支援する。  顧客の入居・退去に伴う手続きを管理し、円滑な受け入れと退去対応を行う。     要件     ホテル・ホスピタリティ業界、または高品質な顧客サービスを提供する職種で3年以上の実務経験。  日本語が流暢で、ビジネスレベルの英語によるコミュニケーションが可能な方。  スタッフの指導・監督、またはチームマネジメントの経験。  優れた顧客対応力と、顧客との長期的な信頼関係を構築できる能力。  Microsoft Office（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）を業務で活用できるスキル。  顧客管理におけるCRMシステムの使用経験があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。  ホテルまたはサービスオフィスの運営管理システムに関する知識があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。  変化の速い業務環境において、複数の業務を優先順位に沿って管理できる能力。  課題に対して主体的に取り組み、適切な解決策を導き出せる問題解決力。  海外・外国籍の顧客への対応経験があれば尚可（必須ではありません）。     福利厚生 :    月曜日から金曜日の勤務スケジュール、週末や夜間はなし

title: Customer Success Employee Pigs

description: Er du vores næste stjerne i grisesektoren?     Hos AgroVision handler det om intelligente softwareløsninger, der gør en forskel for moderne landbrug. Til vores Sektor Gris søger vi en kollega, der ikke blot besvarer spørgsmål, men aktivt tænker i helhedsløsninger.  Sammen med dit team hjælper du vores kunder med at udvikle deres forretning. Det giver dig en arbejdsdag med tæt kundekontakt, faglige udfordringer og masser af variation.      Din profil   Du har kendskab til griseproduktion og har opnået praktisk erfaring i eller omkring stalden gennem arbejde, uddannelse, egen landbrugsproduktion eller anden tilknytning til branchen. Du forstår den daglige drift med tilhørende kompleksiteter hos de mange forskellige produktionstyper og kan omsætte din praktiske viden til konkrete og brugbare løsninger.     Du kommunikerer naturligt med landmænd, rådgivere og andre aktører i branchen, og du trives i en international organisation med fire hovedteams placeret i flere lande.     Du er serviceminded, nysgerrig og motiveres af at arbejde på tværs af de nordiske markeder og kulturer. title: Asiakasratkaisuinsinööri
description: Haemme asiakasratkaisuinsinööriä kaukolämmön palvelutuotanto- ja myyntitiimiin vastaamaan asiakaslähtöisestä ongelmanratkaisusta, asiakasyhteistyöstä ja palveluiden kehittämisestä.      Saat päävastuun palvelutuotantotiimimme lisäarvo- ja olosuhdevalvontapalveluista ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten niitä kehitetään, tuotteistetaan ja viedään asiakkaiden käyttöön. Koordinoit palveluihin liittyvää toimittajaverkostoa ja järjestelmiä sekä valmistelet sopimus- ja kehitystarpeita päätöksentekoon.     Sinulle on tärkeää, että asiakas saa toimivia ratkaisuja ja konkreettista hyötyä palveluistamme. Seuraat ratkaisujen toimivuutta käyttöönoton jälkeen ja tunnistat mahdollisuuksia niiden kehittämiseen ja optimointiin. Haluat ratkaista teknisiä ja taloudellisia haasteita yhteistyössä muiden kanssa ja kehittää palveluista entistä toimivampia ja kannattavampia. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä muiden porienergialaisten ja palvelutoimittajien kanssa.     Sinulla voi olla jo kokemusta energia-, LVI- tai automaatioalalta, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme oppimishalua, teknistä uteliaisuutta ja rohkeutta tarttua uusiin asioihin. Odotamme, että sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva insinöörin (AMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin koulutus. Tässä työssä tarvitset hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja.     Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja mielenkiintoisen tehtäväkentän kehittyvässä energiayhtiössä sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä työssäsi. Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus osittaiseen etätyöhön.     Haethan tehtävää 22.11.2026 mennessä osoitteessa www.porienergia.fi/rekry.     Yhteyshenkilö: Roni Vahamäki, kaupallinen päällikkö, puh. 044 701 2331, roni.vahamaki@porienergia.fi

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Data & AI Strategic Consultant
description:
Functieomschrijving

Als consultant help jij onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten, van strategie tot werkende praktijk. Je overbrugt de kloof tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat klanten betere, datagedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen.

Over ons team

Wij zijn een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie personen. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het échte probleem van de klant. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

title: Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

About P1 Security

Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces.

Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub).

Job Description

Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions

We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide.

Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies.

This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives.

description:
About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

description:

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we have recently expanded into North America and the rest of Europe.

GTM engineering at Luminovo is part of Revenue Operations, the department that sits between marketing, sales and customer success and makes sure our revenue organisation runs smoothly.

We work closely with Account Executives, the BDR team and marketing and directly contribute to pipeline generation.

As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps.

There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works.

You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows.

Über Nelly

Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann. title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description:
THE POSITION

ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory.

This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented.

Missions :

  • Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge).

  • Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods.

  • Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup.

  • Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods.

You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team.

Location: Toulouse (city centre)

Start: As soon as possible

Duration: 6 months

Vos missions

Descriptif du poste

Vous serez en charge de piloter un centre de profit en conformité avec la stratégie de l’entreprise et en lien avec un Responsable Commercial. Vous aurez pour mission de gérer une équipe et de l’accompagner quotidiennement par votre savoir-faire et votre savoir-être et serez en charge de l’accompagner dans sa montée en compétence, dans le respect des valeurs de l’entreprise et de son image de marque.

Vous serez le/la garant(e) du climat de votre boutique en créant une ambiance motivante et propice à l’épanouissement professionnel.

Doté(e) d’une véritable culture du résultat et des chiffres, vous maîtrisez parfaitement vos indicateurs de performance. Vous êtes moteur dans l’atteinte de vos objectifs et dans la réussite des challenges. Votre sens de l’organisation, votre sens commercial et du résultat, votre leadership vous permettront de relever le challenge avec succès.

Aubade - Nîmes
CDI 35H

Vos compétences

Issu(e) d’une formation en management commercial, vous avez acquis une première expérience dans la gestion de boutique et le management d’équipe. Rigoureux (se), organisé(e) avec le sens des priorités, vous êtes doté(e) d’excellentes capacités relationnelles et d’une forte sensibilité produit. Vous démontrez d’un véritable tempérament commercial orienté résultats, associé à un fort sens du service clients.

D’excellente présentation, vous êtes charismatique et connaissez le domaine du luxe.

Avantages

Primes, Tickets Restaurants, Remboursement des titres de transport à hauteur de 50%

title: Sales Expert
description:
Chez Entrepreneurs.com, nous accompagnons des dirigeants dans la transformation stratégique et la croissance de leur entreprise.

Notre mission :
aider des entrepreneurs à construire des entreprises solides, scalables et profitables.

Des milliers de dirigeants ont déjà bénéficié de nos méthodes, de nos frameworks et de notre communauté.

Aujourd’hui, nous renforçons notre équipe de 40 experts et recherchons un consultant stratégique senior capable d’accompagner des entrepreneurs ambitieux vers leur prochain niveau de croissance.

Vos missions

Vous accompagnez un portefeuille d’entrepreneurs dans la structuration et l’accélération de leur croissance commerciale.

Votre impact repose sur votre capacité à :

  • diagnostiquer rapidement une organisation commerciale
  • identifier les leviers de croissance prioritaires
  • clarifier la stratégie d’acquisition et de vente
  • transformer les objectifs commerciaux en actions concrètes
  • responsabiliser les dirigeants dans l’exécution

Votre mission consiste à apporter clarté, structure et accélération commerciale.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Accompagner jusqu’à 60 dirigeants dans le développement de leurs ventes
  • Identifier les goulots d’étranglement commerciaux
  • Construire des roadmaps commerciales claires et actionnables
  • Challenger les décisions liées à l’acquisition et à la vente
  • Suivre l’exécution et la performance commerciale
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des frameworks d’accompagnement
  • Participer à la création de nouveaux outils et contenus liés à la croissance commerciale

Vous apportez de la valeur sur plusieurs dimensions clés.

Domaines d’intervention

  • Acquisi

title: Ingénieur R&D (F/H)
description:
Le travail en équipe, l’épanouissement personnel et professionnel au travail sont des valeurs importantes pour vous ?

Vous êtes à la recherche de sens et de challenges professionnels ?

Rejoignez-nous !

JACIR - société du groupe COFINAIR qui regroupe 4 sites production en France, en Allemagne et en Italie, 290 personnes pour 70M€ CA – se positionne aujourd’hui comme le partenaire incontournable Européen en proposant des technologies innovantes de refroidissement évaporatif respectueuses de l’environnement : design, fabrication, commercialisation, Services dédiés aux tours de refroidissement et refroidisseurs adiabatiques pour l’industrie et le tertiaire.

Son expansion amène JACIR à recruter pour son site de Croissy-Beaubourg :

Vos missions

Véritable acteur du développement de nos produits, vous serez amené(e) à :

  • Piloter des études de R&D en analysant de nouveaux concepts ou des pistes d'amélioration, puis en synthétisant vos conclusions dans des notes techniques.
  • Imaginer et concevoir des solutions innovantes en recherchant le meilleur équilibre entre performances techniques, faisabilité industrielle et maîtrise des coûts.
  • Participer aux campagnes d'essais thermiques et acoustiques, réalisées sur notre station d'essais de Dieppe ou directement sur les installations de nos clients en France, afin de valider les performances des développements.
  • Rédiger les spécifications techniques des nouveaux équipements (en français et ponctuellement en anglais), consulter les fournisseurs et analyser leurs propositions pour identifier les solutions les plus adaptées.
  • Coordonner les partenaires techniques (laboratoires et sous-traitants R&D) en assurant le suivi de leurs travaux et le respect des objectifs définis.

title: Umschulung/Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker Systemintegration ab sofort (w/m/d)
description:
Über uns

Willst du mit uns gemeinsam eine der konservativsten Branchen überhaupt revolutionieren und in kurzer Zeit lernen, wie man exzellenten IT-Support leistet und ein Unternehmen mit Weitblick entwickelt? Dann verstärke unser Team im wunderschönen Herzen Oberfrankens, der Weltkulturerbestadt Bamberg.
Maximal Dental ist ein führendes Dental IT-Systemhaus, welches Zahnarztpraxen aus ganz Deutschland tagtäglich den Rücken freihält, um sich auf Ihr Kerngeschäft – das Wohl der Patienten zu konzentrieren. Unser Unternehmen vereint langjährig erprobtes Praxiswissen mit unkomplizierten Lösungsansätzen und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Dadurch gelingt es uns Deutschlands Zahnarztpraxen zu digitalisieren und ihnen langfristig in allen Belangen rund um die IT-Sicherheit und den IT-Betrieb als starker Partner zur Seite zu stehen.

Suchst du einen Ausbildungsbetrieb, bei dem du nicht nur IT-Systeme, sondern auch dein Know-How auf das nächste Level hebst? Bei Maximal Dental in Bamberg wartet deine Chance, die Dentalbranche zu revolutionieren!

Aufgaben

Und so sieht Dein Spielfeld während deiner Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration bei uns aus:

  • Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von IT-Projekten - darunter Ausstattung von Zahnarztpraxen mit IT-Hardware und Telefonanlagen
  • Vor-Ort Installation, Konfiguration und Migration maßgeschneiderter Systemlösungen für die IT-Infrastruktur unserer Kunden (Serverumzüge, Client-Installationen, Netzwerkhardware, Firewalls, etc.)
  • Betreuung von Client-Server-Systemen (MS Windows Server, Active Directory, Branchensoftware)
  • Beantwortung von Helpdesk Anfragen rund um die Praxis-IT im per Telefon & Mail sowie über unseren zentralen Chat
  • Überwachung und Pflege unseres Netzwerk-Monitoring-Systems
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Netzwerkdokumentationen
  • Analyse und Beseitigung von Störungen und Anwenderproblemen

title: Founders Associate Intern (m/w/d) - Hybrid
description:
PatientFirst Fertility baut eine der ambitioniertesten digital-first Gruppen moderner IVF-Kliniken im Privatzahlersegment - mit klarer Skalierungslogik und schlankem HQ. Die erste Klinik ist live und profitabel. Jetzt kommt die Phase, in der aus einer Klinik eine Gruppe wird.

Du bist die rechte Hand des Gründers und arbeitest an dem, was gerade den größten Hebel hat. Heute eine Marktanalyse, morgen ein Klinikprozess, übermorgen ein Behördenantrag. Du brauchst keine feste Rollenbeschreibung, sondern den Ehrgeiz, jedes Problem zu lösen, das vor dir liegt - und den Instinkt, die Probleme zu erkennen, die noch keiner benannt hat.

Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer (Ex-Harvard, Ex-BCG) und dem C-Level, bekommst ab Tag eins echte Themen mit Verantwortung und siehst aus erster Reihe, wie eine skalierbare Plattform im Gesundheitswesen entsteht. Das Praktikum ist der Einstieg: Wer liefert, übernimmt danach eine feste Rolle.

Aufgaben

Automation & Analyse

  • Reporting: monatliche Sheets und PDFs, Ad-hoc-Analysen bis in den Management- und Shareholder-Kreis
  • Google-Ads-Operations sowie Funnel- und Tracking-QA innerhalb unserer bestehenden Architektur
  • Digitalisierung und Automatisierung der laufenden Klinik: Patientenerfahrung verbessern, Prozesse verschlanken, Fehlerquoten senken, Skalierbarkeit sichern

Operations & Daily Support

  • Direkter Support des C-Levels
  • Recruiting-Koordination: Sichtung, Terminierung, Feedback einsammeln
  • HR-Administration der Klinik
  • Bestellwesen nach Kategorienlogik, Wartungen, Lieferantenkoordination
  • Schnittstelle zur Klinik: Bindeglied zwischen HQ und klinischem Team
  • Tool- & System-Ownership: Mitverantwortung für unseren operativen Tool-Stack

Aufbau- & Skalierungsprojekte

  • Strategische Aufbau- und Wachstumsprojekte der Gruppe: von neuer klinischer

title: Visiting Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
Visiting Analyst Venture Capital – Investment Team (all genders)
📍 Hamburg · 6 months, full-time. Start: January 2027

Our core belief is that the global food system needs to be rethought and transformed in the next decade - and our job is to back the most daring founders building towards that future. Oyster Bay is a European Food- & AgTech early-stage fund, investing from Seed to Series A across the entire food value chain: from autonomous robots, biotech and crop genetics, to tomorrow’s favourite consumer brands.

We’re a close-knit team of ten, with seven of us on the investment side. As a Visiting Analyst, you will be a full member of the investment team from day one.

What you’ll actually do:

  • Develop your own investment thesis, build conviction about where value will be created, and connect with companies shaping that space.

  • Take part in investment processes end to end, from first call to decision. That includes market assessment, business model evaluation and building founder relationships.

Above all, it’s important to us that you have high agency. That you take a problem, run with it and figure it out along the way. That also means you think for yourself, have strong opinions which you aren’t afraid to voice, and have an exceptional work ethic.

Our values are:

  • No assholes

  • Always learning

  • Results driven

  • Radical honesty

title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) Power BI mit Entscheidungsbefugnis
description:
Über uns

Die Weiler Consult GmbH ist eine Power-BI-Boutique für den deutschen Mittelstand und das Konzernumfeld. Rund 10 Power-BI-Expertinnen und -Experten bauen Reporting, das Geschäftsführer und CFOs wirklich nutzen. Unser Prinzip: Wir sind der Sherpa. Wir arbeiten remote-first, deutschlandweit, und treffen uns dreimal im Jahr zur Workation.

Worum es geht

Du bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, vom Kickoff bis zur Verlängerung. Du machst sichtbar, was unsere Power-BI-Arbeit in den Zahlen des Kunden verändert, und steuerst die Umsetzung mit Entwicklern und Freelancern. In deiner Verantwortung liegen rund 10 bis 12 Kunden.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst die Kundenbeziehungen, kennst Ziele und Kennzahlen deiner Kunden und hältst ihr Feedback in ClickUp fest.

  • Du benennst die Veränderung in den Zahlen des Kunden, nicht die gelieferten Dashboards.

  • Mit jedem Kunden führst du pro Quartal ein Strategie- und Roadmap-Gespräch: Zufriedenheit, Erfolge, Zielbild für zwei Jahre, Roadmap.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

title: Photonic Component Modelling Engineer
description:
About Us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We’re moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Photonic Component Modelling Engineer to build and qualify behavioral and compact models that accurately capture the underlying device physics. Your models will be the foundation for system-level verification of systems that combine photonic and electronic components.

You’ll need to understand how a component’s behavior shifts with its surrounding optical and electrical circuitry and with operating conditions.

What You’ll Do

Working closely with the system verification, photonic design, and photonic characterization teams, you will:

  • Develop and maintain models of optical primitives (modulators, switches, photodetectors, couplers, etc.) for simulation and system verification environments

  • Verify that models accurately represent device physics across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners

  • Release models that pass defined QA criteria

  • Verify PDK component libraries so that PDK updates and process variations don’t break circuit-level simulations

  • Extract model parameters from lab measurements

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Service Delivery Manager   We’re looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to take ownership of end-to-end service delivery for key customers, ensuring consistently high levels of performance, governance and customer satisfaction.     You’ll work closely with customers, internal technical teams, suppliers and third parties to ensure services meet agreed SLAs, KPIs and contractual commitments. Acting as a trusted operational partner and escalation point, you’ll play a key role in service performance, major incident management, continuous improvement and operational governance.      What you’ll be doing    Own and manage end-to-end service delivery across customer accounts.  Ensure services consistently meet agreed SLAs, KPIs, OLAs and contractual commitments.  Oversee Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management in line with ITIL best practice.  Review major incidents, ensuring effective communication, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.  Monitor service performance, identifying risks, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.  Lead regular service reviews, operational calls and governance meetings with customers and stakeholders.  Act as an escalation point for complex operational and service issues.  Provide clear and professional customer communication during incidents, changes and service challenges.  Coordinate internal technical teams, SIAM functions, suppliers and third-party partners.  Ensure new services are effectively onboarded and transitioned into live operations.  Identify and drive Continuous Service Improvement initiatives, using service data and trends to improve quality and reduce incidents.  Produce and present service reports, dashboards and performance updates to customers and senior stakeholders.  Maintain service risks, issues, actions, processes and operational documentation.  Support contract renewals and changes to service scope from an operational perspective.  Ensure service delivery meets relevant security, resilience, audit, data protection and business continuity requirements.  Support audits, risk assessments and compliance reviews alongside Quality and Security teams.  Influence technical solutions and coordinate remediation activity where required.       What we’re looking for       Essential    Proven experience as a Service Delivery Manager, Service Manager or similar within a managed services environment.  Knowledge of managed services across areas such as cloud, infrastructure, networks or applications.  Experience supporting customers within financial services or another regulated environment.  Strong understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change and Service Level Management.  Experience managing SLAs, KPIs, service performance and customer-facing reporting.  Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including working with senior customer stakeholders.  Strong operational governance, risk management and problem-solving skills.  Abi

title: Operations Manager - Central Europe (m/w/d)
description: 100 % remote – von überall in Deutschland    Über Eleiko   Seit 1957 steht Eleiko für Kraftsportgeräte auf höchstem Niveau – von olympischen Wettkämpfen bis hin zu den besten Trainingseinrichtungen der Welt. Von unserem Hauptsitz im schwedischen Halmstad aus betreuen wir Kunden auf der ganzen Welt. Wir wachsen schnell und verfolgen ein klares Ziel: das weltweit führende Unternehmen im Kraftsport zu werden. Dieses Ziel erreichen wir gemeinsam, getragen von unseren Werten Performance, Learning und Kindness.  Für unsere Region Central Europe suchen wir jetzt eine erfahrene, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die mit anpackt und unseren Operations-Bereich aufbaut und weiterentwickelt.   Deine Rolle   Als Operations Manager leitest Du unseren Operations-Bereich, der Customer Support, Installation und Service vereint, und baust ihn gezielt auf und weiter aus. Du übernimmst die disziplinarische Führung eines Teams im Aufbau und berichtest direkt an unseren Regional Director Central Europe. Zudem bist Du Teil des lokalen Managementteams in der Region und arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem gesamten Unternehmen zusammen.  Du startest mit einem kleinen Team und bist aktiv in das Tagesgeschäft eingebunden. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Bereich für die Zukunft auf. Wir wachsen insbesondere in den Bereichen Service, Installation und After Sales, und Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle dabei, wie sich unser Unternehmen auf dieses Wachstum ausrichtet.   Deine Aufgaben   Du verantwortest die Customer Journey vom Auftragseingang bis zur Auslieferung – mit dem Ziel, unseren Kunden in jeder Phase ein reibungsloses und hochwertiges Erlebnis zu bieten. Zu Deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören:    Führung und Weiterentwicklung des Teams mit Fokus auf Wachstum, Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit  Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, KPIs und SLAs sowie Ergebnisverfolgung und Reporting  Steuerung von Installation, After Sales und einem strukturierten Reklamationsmanagement  Unterstützung von Field Sales und Key Account Management bei Angeboten, Ausschreibungen und Produktfragen  Organisation von Messen und Events  Einführung neuer Systeme und Prozesse, einschließlich Schulung des Teams    Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von vielfältigen Kontakten. Intern arbeitest Du eng mit Vertrieb, Lager, Einkauf, Qualität, unserem Hauptsitz in Schweden sowie Kolleginnen und Kollegen in anderen Ländern zusammen. Extern stehst Du im Austausch mit Kunden, Installationspartnern und Logistikdienstleistern.   Dein Profil   Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Operations, Kundenservice, After Sales oder Servicemanagement, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld. MigMig brings everything they need into one platform: online ordering, table QR ordering and payment, reservations, a point-of-sale register, a kitchen display system, menu management, and a branded website.  Great software is only half the story. The other half is the person who walks an owner through it, earns their trust, and helps them grow. We're looking for that person.  As our Customer Success & Onboarding Specialist, you'll be the first voice our partners hear and the one they come back to. You'll bring new businesses onto MigMig, guide them from signup to their first live order, and stay with them as they grow. You won't just answer questions. Your businesses are live, active, and using more of the platform each month, and your ideas are already improving how we onboard. title: Client Success Manager
description: Looking for your next Client Success role in SaaS? Join our AI Paralegal startup within an established, successful LegalTech business - generous commission structure   Small, collaborative team - you'll work directly with our product teams to help shape the product our clients want  Help law firms start earning revenue from AI Paralegal and widen access to justice for their clients  Flexible, hybrid Sydney or Brisbane based role - 2 days a week in the office with regular travel     About AI Paralegal   AI Paralegal is part of CORTO, a cutting-edge software company dedicated to revolutionising the legal industry. Our mission is to empower legal practitioners with AI-driven solutions that streamline their workflow, boost productivity and provide more efficient client service.  AI is transforming the legal industry and CORTO is at the forefront of this change. There is a huge opportunity for law firms to save time, money and to add more value to their client base. This is where AI Paralegal comes in. AI Paralegal is a startup transforming the way legal work is done to unlock new value for law firms and their clients. Built on Adieu's advanced AI technology, AI Paralegal functions as a digital paralegal drafting documents, managing workflows and handling repetitive legal tasks with speed and precision. By integrating seamlessly with LEAP's ecosystem, it empowers firms to increase efficiency, scale capacity and drive measurable profitability from every matter.    What you'll do   We're looking for an experienced Client Success Manager to slot into our Implementation team and focus on adoption - you'll take new firms from signed order form to using AI Paralegal every day.  AI Paralegal runs on a revenue share model: when our clients use the product successfully, we both generate revenue. That makes a firm's first four months critical. In that window, you'll get them set up, trained and confident with the product, with the goal of reaching their monthly usage targets. Those targets are how your success will be measured.  You'll work closely with sales, product and our engagement team, and your client interaction and feedback will help shape how we run this first part of the client journey.    To make this happen, you will:    Own the end-to-end implementation experience for new firms, from contract signed through to embedded daily usage and live revenue  Partner with sales across the full cycle, joining the conversation before the deal closes and staying close after  Lead onsite and remote training sessions tailored to the firm: structured pre-work, a half to full day onsite for smaller firms and deliberate follow-up  Run targeted outreach after go-live to help firms reach their monthly usage targets  Run a clean handoff to the engagement team once firms are settled, so they can optimise long-term usa
