title: Onboarding Manager
description: At Sonder, we believe every person deserves to feel safe, supported, and empowered to be at their best, wherever they are. We’re redefining workplace health, safety, and wellbeing through a seamless blend of technology and human expertise. Sonder’s mobile platform provides 24/7, real-time support from a dedicated team of safety, medical, and mental health professionals, ensuring members receive immediate care when they need it most.  Since our founding in 2017, we’ve grown rapidly across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. Backed by Seek and Blackbird, we now support over one million members and 200+ team members globally. About The Role   As our Onboarding manager you will have the ownership of how Sonder’s customers go live and adopt our platform. Reporting to the Senior Customer Support Operations Manager you will lead the strategy and delivery of our onboarding program, with a focus on our customers who have purchased premium onboarding or enterprise organisations, ensuring the standard for every customer we onboard is top - class. Success is measured by activation, adoption, customer satisfaction and how well our onboarding scales, so you’ll be accountable for getting customers to real value, not just to launch day. title: Renewals Manager
description: The Opportunity:  Renewals Manager  LifeLoop is hiring a Renewals Manager to own recontracts, manual renewals, dispositions, and replacement orders, work that has been split across our CSMs and account managers. Owning it centrally frees CSMs to focus on strategic, value, and adoption conversations, and frees account managers to focus on expansion and growth deals.   What To Expect In The Role   The Renewals Manager owns the renewal motion for dispositions (i.e., M&A of customer communities), manual renewals, recontracts, and replacement orders, working alongside CSMs and account managers across every segment.    Own upcoming dispositions, manual renewals, recontracts/consolidations, and replacement orders across all current customer segments including Strategic, Enterprise, Mid-Market, and SMB.  Begin work 180+ days before each renewal date, and keep a clear view of the next 90 to 180 days of upcoming renewals.  Move customers off legacy contracts to current, more favorable terms including pricing, payment, products, and term length.  Lead renewal, contract, and pricing negotiations with customers.  Help shape LifeLoop's renewal uplift percentages and strategy.  Maintain a weekly opportunity forecast and SFDC data hygiene for all renewals, dispositions, and manual renewals.  Assist with monthly and quarterly renewals and disposition forecasting.  Partner with CSMs to flag priority accounts each quarter, and make sure you have the right customer contacts for renewals and dispositions.  Work with account managers on upcoming renewals so they can spend their time on expansion and growth deals.  When a disposition or manual renewal does not result in a recontract, partner with the CSM to process cancellation requests properly and explore potential contract saves.  Join the high-risk and churn meetings with ELT, SLT, and CS leadership, and raise renewal risk early.  Use AI tools to develop more efficient methods of customer outreach, value positioning, and forecasting for renewals and dispositions.  Assist with quoting hardware replacement orders on an as-needed basis.  Communicate clearly and proactively with customers, internal partners, and leadership on status, risks, and next steps.     Performance Expectations     We expect the Renewals Manager to help the company protect and grow recurring revenue, with numeric targets set in the annual variable compensation plan.  Meet or exceed renewal bookings targets (renewals quota)   Manage manual renewals 180+ days ahead of the renewal date  Work to recontract dispositions within the 30-day recontract policy window  Partner with the account teams (CSMs and AMs) on large account opportunities to close renewals and support expansion growth  Maintain a weekly forecast with a high level of accuracy  Move legacy contracts to current, more favorable terms  Deliver renewal pricing and uplift outcomes through effective contract and pricing negotiation  Close a high percentage of renewals on time or ahead

title: Staff AI Engineer — Agent Platform (all genders)
description:
wingmaite captures the knowledge companies never write down: who decides what, how work actually gets done, and why decisions were made. Our AI agents use that knowledge to answer questions and get work done.

We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner.

What You'll Do

  • Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system.

  • Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain.

  • Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act.

  • Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date.

  • Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself.

  • Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design.

How We Work

We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly.

What This Role Is Not

A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or securit

title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description:
We are Metrify Smart Metering, Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal.

Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. Our mission is to enable utilities, grid operators, and energy providers to install and operate smart meters. Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing.

While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities

Automate the operations behind every meter exchange

Metrify's Multi-Family Home team runs meter exchanges in apartment buildings, and your code will help run them. In a team of seven, you'll turn the operations we do by hand into automations that save time, reduce errors, and ship faster.

What you'll do

  • Develop the automation layer on our ERP system.

  • Write Python scripts that pull and process data from internal and external APIs, Airtable, and our ERP interface.

  • Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case.

title: Product Specialist
description:
Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.

YOUR MISSION

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.

  • Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an Opto-mechanical Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and play a critical role in the design, integration, and manufacturing of opto-mechanical systems for our photonic products. This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

title: Non-Destructive Testing Technician – Level 2
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission

You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.


What you will do

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
About Virtual Identity

 

Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams.

You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field.

This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting.

 

What you will do:

  • Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact.

title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight.

This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence.

Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits.

  • Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements.

  • Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors.

  • Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies.

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)

title: Velocity Account Executive - SMB (English)
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France: an AI agent runs the entire sale and purchase journey end-to-end, orchestrating local brokers, portals, buyers, and documents.

Backed by €60 million from top-tier investors Sequoia Capital and Kima Ventures, we're committed to accelerating life changes for millions of current and future European homeowners.

Your Mission

Zefir is hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product and Ops, and the Talent team is the engine behind it. You'll join as the first Talent Acquisition intern, working day to day with our Founding Talent Lead, in a team that reports directly to the CEO.

This is not an admin internship. You'll own real pipelines, talk to candidates every day, and help build the AI-powered recruiting machine we run on. By the end of the six months, you'll have recruited people who are still at Zefir years later.

 

What You'll Do

Find and engage talent | About 70%

Help us find the people who will build Zefir's next chapter.

title: Brand Director
description:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

title: Financial Administrator
description:
Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋

Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it.

I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it.

We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it.

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies

About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
description:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

title: ML Researcher
description:
About Us

Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private and always available on your device.

We’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of on-device AI, from silicon-level optimizations to distributed inference systems.

The Role

We’re looking for a Founding ML Researcher to work at the frontier of on-device AI. This role is for someone who identifies problems and potentials, designs and executes experiments and derives insights that translate into real-world performance.

You’ll have significant ownership over our research agenda and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes.

What You’ll Work On

  • Inference research: Identifying and validating new approaches to on-device efficiency, including speculative decoding variants, novel quantization schemes and entirely new techniques yet to be discovered

  • Autoresearch pipelines: Designing systems that can autonomously explore, hypothesize and evaluate research ideas that accelerate our R&D loop

  • Evaluations and benchmarks: Developing rigorous evals that measure performance in the real world, outside of clean academic settings

description:
About MotherDuck

Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.

What you will do

The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.

Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Deliveroo connects millions of consumers with the restaurants and brands they love. Our Integrated Marketing team sits at the heart of how we bring those relationships to life — combining customer insight, commercial opportunity and creativity to drive growth for Deliveroo and our partners.

Within Central Integrated Marketing, the Merchant & Ads team sets the global strategy for how we partner with merchants to help them grow on our marketplace and create compelling reasons for consumers to choose Deliveroo. Ads & Monetization Strategy

  • Own the Restaurants specific ads

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive Zip’s expansion into global enterprises with $7B+ in revenue. This is a high-impact, consultative sales role requiring deep industry expertise, a hunter mentality, and a passion for solving complex procurement challenges.

 

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle: Engage C-level executives, influence stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, legal, and operations, and navigate long, complex deal cycles.

  • Drive new business: While supported by BDRs and marketing, you’ll proactively prospect and leverage your network to develop a strong pipeline.

title: Senior Konzepter Social Media (m/w/d)
description:
Jobteaser

Social Media ist für dich kein Kanal, auf den man eine Kampagne am Ende noch irgendwie draufadaptiert. Sondern ein Ort, an dem Marken Teil von Kultur werden können.

Du weißt, was Menschen zum Stoppen, Teilen, Kommentieren oder Weiterschicken bringt. Du erkennst einen guten Insight oder einen Trend, bevor daraus eine Idee wird – und eine gute Idee, bevor daraus Content wird. Und du kannst beides: konzipieren und schreiben.

Wir suchen einen Senior Konzepter Social Media, der oder die Social Media versteht, Ideen entwickelt und Marken wie Oberbräu und der AOK Baden-Württemberg eine Stimme gibt, die man nach zwei Sekunden nicht wieder vergessen hat.

Damit bringst du uns weiter

  • Du entwickelst Social-first-Ideen und kreative Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und Always-on-Kommunikation
  • Du übersetzt Strategie, Cultural Insights und Plattformmechaniken in Ideen, die Menschen tatsächlich interessieren
  • Du konzipierst und textest vom ersten Gedanken bis zur fertigen Umsetzung: Hooks, Headlines, Captions, Scripts, Formate und Kampagnenideen
  • Du denkst nicht einfach TikTok oder Meta – du verstehst, warum Menschen sich dort wie verhalten
  • Du entwickelst Ideen gemeinsam mit unseren anderen Crafts weiter
  • Du präsentierst deine Konzepte überzeugend – intern genauso wie bei unseren Kunden
  • Du gibst Feedback, schärfst Ideen und hebst gemeinsam mit anderen die kreative Messlatte

Das wünschen wir uns von dir

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Konzeption, Copywriting und Kreation, idealerweise in einer Kreativ-, Social- oder Digitalagentur
  • Ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität, Storytelling und Marken
  • Erfahrung mit Social-first-Kampagnen, Content-Formaten und Bewegtbild
  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, was eine starke Markenidee von einem kurzfristigen Trend unterscheidet
  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Popkultur

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

At Cenosco, we build Asset Integrity Management Software trusted by global leaders in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Energy and beyond. We are building a new data platform from the ground up, and we need a Senior Data Engineer to shape it: the architecture, the tooling, and the single source of truth our products and teams will rely on.

You will join the Data Engineering team, make real architectural decisions, and bring a pioneering mindset. No tools are set in stone, so we expect you to propose what works best and back it with reasoning.

What You'll Do

Platform & Architecture

  • Design and build our data platform from scratch, from ingestion to modelling to consumption

  • Take part in architectural decisions and help choose the right technologies (Snowflake, Databricks, or something you propose)

  • Research, evaluate, and implement a single source of truth across our data landscape

Data Integration

  • Connect and consolidate data from multiple IMS databases and other heterogeneous sources

  • Design and build reliable, scalable ELT/ETL pipelines

  • Develop data models that serve both product and analytical needs

title: Graduate Sales Development Representative
description:
Thanks for stopping by and learning more about this role at Sitemate! ✨🏗️

We’d love to hear from you 👩‍💻👩🏽‍💻🧑🏿‍💻👨🏻‍💻

📝 Overview

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets.

 

Room to grow, fast-tracked

We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged

description:

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

title: Technicien d'essais sur avion H/F
description:
Dans le cadre de nos différentes activités, nous sommes aujourd’hui reconnus comme des acteurs incontournables dans le domaine des essais aéronautiques sur FAL A320/A330/A321, avant la livraison des avions neufs. Sous-traitant du plus grand constructeur d'avions, notre ambition est d'acquérir de nouveaux marchés et contribuer au quotidien à la satisfaction de nos clients. Pour cela, nous pouvons compter sur nos équipes qui contribuent au quotidien à la performance et à la croissance de notre structure.

Sous la responsabilité du chef d’équipe, les techniciens d’essais aéronautiques réalisent les essais nécessaires en vue de l'attestation de conformité du produit.

Vos missions

𝐑𝐞́𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐬 :

- Dérouler les procédures de test sur A320/A330/A321,

- Procéder à la pose & dépose des outillages et équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des essais,

- Réaliser les essais fonctionnels sur les systèmes de l'avion en vue de l'attestation de conformité,

- Rechercher les pannes (recherche de plan, trouble shooting, sonnage, mesure de tension, etc.).

𝐒𝐮𝐢𝐯𝐢 𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐞́𝐬 :

- Rédiger les différents avis suite aux problèmes rencontrés,

- Assurer le suivi informatique des essais (attestation des essais, réalisation de reprise d'essais, archivage, etc.),

- Procéder à l'amélioration continue des process industriels,

- Participer aux passages avion pour transferts des points vers les postes suivants,

- Piloter l'activité des assistants essais sur le poste.

Vos compétences

Le type de profil que nous recherchons :

- Formation aéronautique (avionique, mécanique, système) ou électrotechnique, idéalement BAC+2

- Connaissances dans les essais systèmes : commandes de vol, trains….

- Connaissance de la FAL

- Un bon relationnel et une capacité à travailler en équipe

- Un réel intérêt pour le secteur aérona

KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. The role
We're hiring an Investor Relations Associate to grow the investor side of Pairs: the family offices, VCs and strategic investors our founders raise from. title: Venture Partner
description:
We are hiring a Venture Partner to bring new opportunities into Pairs, and to grow the network of investors who see them first.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angels, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • New opportunities. Companies raising Series A and later, brought to Pairs with the context our team needs to assess them.

  • Network growth. New relationships every month with family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angel investors who are new to Pairs.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about direct investors, not fund LPs.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role

Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.

Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.

Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.

AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.

Company

Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

 

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production.

 

Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features.

 

Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Strategy & Enablement, EMEA

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

title: 사업 운영 매니저 (Business Operations Manager)
description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요     토스플레이스의 Business Operations Manager는 Enterprise Sales Team에 속해 있어요.  토스플레이스의 사업 모델과 POS 기반 제품 구조를 깊이 이해하고, 고객·대리점·내부 조직 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 실행을 만들어내는 팀이에요.  단순히 계약을 만드는 것에 그치지 않고, 고객사의 실제 환경에 맞게 솔루션이 적용되고 비즈니스 성과로 이어지는 것까지 함께 고민해요.  Business Operations Manager는 이 팀 안에서, 세일즈 이후의 전 과정을 책임지며 솔루션이 고객사에 빠르게 안착하고 안정적으로 운영되도록 만들어요.  도입부터 운영, 그리고 성과 개선까지 이어지는 전 과정에서 문제를 해결하고 실행을 리딩하는 역할을 담당해요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요     토스플레이스 제품 도입을 위해, 설치부터 안정화까지 고객사와의 협업 여정을 관리하고, 이 과정에서 발견되는 문제를 주도적으로 해결해요.  이 과정에서 다양한 내외부 이해관계자들과의 커뮤니케이션 및 긴밀한 협업이 필요해요.  도입 이후 발생하는 운영 이슈를 해결하고, 안정적인 운영 환경을 만들어요.  고객에게 더 효과적으로 솔루션을 제안할 수 있도록, 제품 이해를 돕는 가이드 자료를 제작해요.  토스플레이스 솔루션에 대한 이해도를 높이기 위한 데모/시연 프로그램을 기획하고 운영해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     오프라인 결제 산업(VAN, POS 솔루션 등)에 대한 실무 이해도를 바탕으로 고객사 관리 업무를 수행하셨던 분이 필요해요.  프랜차이즈 본사나 VAN 대리점에서 포스를 깊이 있게 다뤄보고 운영해보신 분들도 좋아요.  복잡도 높고, 신규 기능이 빠르게 개발되는 환경에서 고객사에게 정확하고 깔끔한 가이드를 제공하실 수 있어야 해요. 이를 위해 포스 솔루션 이해도는 필수에요.  원활한 커뮤니케이션 역량을 바탕으로 고객사의 요구사항에 기민하게 대응하고, 내부 이해관계자들과도 의견을 조율할 수 있는 분을 찾고 있어요.  고객사 운영 과정에서 발생하는 다양한 문제와 요구사항을 정리하고 해결할 수 있는 역량이 필요해요.       토스플레이스로의 합류 여정     서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사

Du er strukturert og analytisk, men samtidig pragmatisk nok til å ta beslutninger og skape fremdrift. Hos Siemens blir du en del av et sterkt og inkluderende fagmiljø. Du får muligheten til å jobbe med teknologi og løsninger som bidrar til utviklingen av fremtidens energiinfrastruktur, samtidig som du får en sentral rolle i å utvikle mennesker og organisasjonen rundt deg. description: ABOUT QUINCE   Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.    We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.     If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. title: (Senior) Account Manager

Sirve regularmente a más de 200.000 puntos de venta en España, Francia, Italia, Portugal, Polonia y Países Bajos. Trabajo de campo  Gestión, planificación y control de diferentes proyectos  Interacción con diversas áreas internas de la compañía, ejerciendo como nexo entre estas áreas y el cliente (Transporte, Almacén, Bback office, calidad para la gestión de auditorías internas y externas)  Reporting actividad diaria y resolución de incidencias. title: Senior Account Manager Grocery

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.  Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.  We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager - Groceries to join our  Milan (Italy)  team. In this role, you’ll act as a strategic consultant for our restaurant partners, using data-driven insights and industry knowledge to lead their growth on our platform.  Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.   What You’ll Be Doing   You’ll be joining the  Grocery  team.  This position is based in Milano. Growth Consulting: Use data manipulation and analysis to identify trends, increasing profitability and growth for both your partners and Deliveroo.  Revenue Generation: Drive commercial value through upselling, cross-selling, and identifying new business opportunities within your portfolio.  Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and Customer Service to develop and implement bespoke solutions that solve partner challenges.  Operational Excellence: Serve as the main point of contact for strategic partners, addressing complex issues with professional, timely, and scalable solutions.     Essential    What You’ll Need to Thrive     Significant commercial experience, with a background in groceries, FMCG, or high-growth technology companies.  Knowledge of the food retail industry, understanding the unique challenges and opportunities within the grocery sector.  Proven ability to manage long-term relationships with strategic stakeholders and global brands.  Professional fluency in Italian and good command of English to collaborate with our global teams and partners.     Why Join Us?   At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. description: Som Service Delivery Manager hos Atea får du ansvaret for relationen omkring den samlede serviceleverance til en række kunder. Du bliver den, der skaber sammenhæng mellem kundens forretning, serviceaftalen og de teams i Atea, der leverer IT-infrastruktur og managed services.     Det kræver, at du både kan udfordre, skabe overblik og få forskellige interesser til at mødes. Til gengæld får du en rolle med betydelig selvstændighed, tæt adgang til kunderne og mulighed for konkret at påvirke både leverancen og samarbejdet.      Dine primære opgaver      Du får et tydeligt ansvar for dine kunder og kvaliteten i deres serviceleverance. Det betyder, at du blandt andet skal:   Eje den samlede serviceleverance og sikre, at den matcher kundens aftaler, behov og forventninger.  Drive service governance og skabe fremdrift gennem opfølgning på SLA’er, aftaler og indsatser.  Opbygge en tæt dialog med kunden og være den primære kontakt, når leverancen skal udvikles, eller noget kræver handling.  Have overblik over servicekontrakten og håndtere fakturering og rentabilitet sammen med account teamet.  Tage styring på eskalationer og samle de rette specialister omkring en løsning.  Identificere forbedringsmuligheder og udvikle kundens services i tæt samarbejde med kunden og interne specialister.       Om dig   Du har erfaring fra en kundevendt rolle inden for IT og managed services og er vant til at tage ansvar for en leverance, der involverer flere interessenter. Du kan eksempelvis arbejde som Service Delivery Manager, IT Service Manager eller IT-chef i dag.     Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:   Har erfaring med større serviceaftaler inden for IT og forstår dynamikken mellem kunde, kontrakt og leverance.  Har en solid forståelse for IT-infrastruktur og managed services, uden at du nødvendigvis selv er teknisk specialist.  Kan opbygge troværdige kunderelationer og samtidig tage de svære dialoger, når forventninger, økonomi eller leverance udfordrer samarbejdet.  Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket over SLA’er, økonomi, rapportering og opfølgning.  Har økonomisk forståelse og kan indgå i dialog om fakturering og rentabilitet.  Kommunikerer sikkert på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.      En relevant videregående IT- eller forretningsmæssig uddannelse, eksempelvis cand.it. eller cand.merc., kan være en fordel, ligesom ITIL eller PRINCE2 kan være relevant. Din dokumenterede erfaring med serviceleverancer og kunder vejer dog tungere end din uddannelsestitel.     Rollen er derimod ikke et naturligt næste skridt, hvis du primært motiveres af selv at arbejde teknisk. Her lykkes du gennem dit ejerskab for kunden og leverancen og gennem din evne til at få andre til at lykkes sammen.      Derfor skal du vælge Atea   Du træder ind i et Service Delivery Management-team med 20 kolleger fordelt på Ballerup, Aarhus og Riga. Her får du erfarne kolleger at sparre med, samtidig med at du har frihed til selv at tilrettelægge arbejdet omkring dine kunder.

title: Serviceleder til brandsikring (ABA)
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for den daglige drift og samtidig udvikle stærke kunderelationer? Vi søger en serviceleder til vores brandsikringsafdeling i Søborg med ansvar for teknikere, kunder og ABA-service.       Din rolle som serviceleder   Du bliver en central del af vores brandsikringsafdeling, som oplever stor vækst. Du får ansvar for den daglige ledelse og koordinering af serviceteknikerne og bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne, teknikerne og vores servicecenter.  Du sikrer, at serviceopgaverne planlægges, prioriteres og gennemføres til tiden, med høj kvalitet og en sund økonomi. Samtidig udvikler du medarbejderne, styrker kundesamarbejdet og skaber vækst gennem serviceaftaler og tillægsarbejder.      Dine primære opgaver    Daglig ledelse, planlægning og disponering af serviceteknikere  Opfølgning på årseftersyn, fejlmeldinger og akutte opgaver  Personaleledelse, oplæring og kompetenceudvikling  Kundekontakt, rådgivning og forventningsafstemning  Budgetopfølgning, fakturering og sikring af en sund indtjening  Kvalitetssikring, servicerapporter og dokumentation       Dine sekundære ansvarsområder    Salg og udvikling af serviceaftaler samt tilbud på tillægsarbejder  Teknisk støtte til serviceteknikerne og faglig eskalation  Koordinering med servicecenter, projektledere og eksterne samarbejdspartnere  Opfølgning på kapacitet, ressourceudnyttelse og arbejdsgange       Hvem er du?    Du har solid erfaring med ABA-anlæg og gerne også AVA, ABV eller ABDL  Du har erfaring som serviceleder, servicekoordinator eller erfaren ABA-servicetekniker  Du er en tydelig og motiverende leder, som følger op og skaber retning  Du arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag  Du har kommerciel forståelse og erfaring med økonomisk opfølgning  Du er serviceminded og kommunikerer professionelt med kunder og medarbejdere  Du er fortrolig med Office-pakken og digitale service- og dokumentationssystemer       Hvad tilbyder vi?    En selvstændig lederstilling med stort ansvar og tydeligt mandat  Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af vores serviceafdeling og dens arbejdsgange  Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer  Korte beslutningsveje og en uformel omgangstone  Løbende efteruddannelse gennem SIF Akademi  En attraktiv lønpakke med pension og gode personalevilkår  Firmabil, telefon og nødvendigt IT-udstyr  En arbejdsplads med mere end 100 års erfaring inden for tekniske installationer       Lyder det som noget for dig?   Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til job@sif.dk, med emnet  "Serviceleder– att.: CBR".   Kontakt afdelingschef  Christian Bjørn Rasmussen  for en uforpligtende snak på 26 32 29 20 eller skriv en mail på CBR@sif.dk.     Vi gør opmærksom på at alle indsendte ansøgninger håndteres i henhold til vores privatlivspolitik.

title: Customer Success Team Lead (German-speaking)
description: Remote within EU time zones     Fluent German and English required    At Secfix, we're at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.  Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with the exception of our DACH sales team, which is based in Munich. We're a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.  We've raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.  This is where careers are made!   About The Role   Our CSM team has grown to five Customer Success Managers, each running a book of customers through ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, NIS 2 and DORA. As the team keeps growing, we're creating a dedicated Team Lead role: a manager who works alongside the CSMs every day and makes their coaching and development a priority! You'll be the line manager for all CSMs and run 1:1s, feedback loops, onboarding, and provide inputs to performance reviews and career development, while keeping a reduced portfolio of your own customers (because we don't think you can coach CSMs well on work you don't do).    You've managed or formally coached CSMs before for at least 1 year and want to keep doing it; this isn't a first step into management  4+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS, ideally with mid-market or DACH Mittelstand customers  Fluent German and English as our CSM team works with customers in both  Comfortable with a revenue component: you've carried an upsell or NRR target yourself and can coach others toward one  You've built automations

title: フィールドサービスマネージャー｜Field Services Manager
description: 職務概要（job Summary）   フィールドサービスマネージャーは、ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン内で利用される各種IT機器およびサービスをサポートするフィールドサービスチームを統括頂きます。  本ポジションでは、POSシステム、ワークステーション、タブレット端末、モバイルデバイスなどの現場配備されたテクノロジーソリューションの運用を担当します。  24時間365日の安定したサービス運用基盤を整え、サービス提供のマネジメント、テクノロジー施策の推進を担います。また、多岐にわたるカウンターパート（パーク運営部門、アプリケーション開発チーム、インフラチーム、サイバーセキュリティチーム、ヘルプデスク、ベンダーおよびビジネス部門）と連携し、パーク全体で信頼性の高いテクノロジーサービスを提供します。   所属チーム（DEPARTMENT）   Global Technology & Innovation  Global Technology & Innovation（GTI）は、約70名規模・8つの機能別チームで構成されており、テーマパークビジネス全体におけるデジタルトランスフォーメーションを推進しています。  チームは、ゲスト体験を向上させるデジタルプロダクトから、企業活動を支えるエンタープライズシステムまで、幅広い領域の企画・導入・運用を担っています。  主な担当領域には、eコマース、チケッティング・入場管理システム、Web・モバイルアプリケーション、ゲームおよび新技術を活用したゲスト体験、フォト認証テクノロジー、アトラクション予約プラットフォーム、飲食プラットフォームとのデジタル連携体験などがあります。また、財務、人事、購買、バックオフィス業務などを支えるコーポレート／エンタープライズシステムの企画・導入にも携わり、パーク運営全体をテクノロジーで支えています。    主な業務内容（RESPONSIBILTIES）       プロジェクトおよびサービス運用管理（30%）   テクノロジープロセスおよびガバナンス基準に沿って、プロジェクトおよび運用活動を管理・実行。  ビジネスステークホルダーおよび社内チームと連携し、テクノロジーの展開、導入、運用準備を支援。    テクニカルサポートおよびベンダー管理（25%）   現場に展開されるハードウェアおよびテクノロジーソリューションに対して、技術的なリーダーシップとサポートを提供。  高いシステム可用性を確保し、ベンダーとの関係およびサービスパフォーマンスを管理。     ステークホルダー管理およびビジネスパートナーシップ（20%）   ビジネスステークホルダー、サービスプロバイダー、テクノロジーチーム、シニアリーダーシップにとって信頼されるパートナーとして行動します。  フィールドテクノロジーサポートおよび運用ベストプラクティスに関するSubject Matter Expert（SME）としての役割を担う。     継続的改善およびサービスエクセレンス（15%）   運用上のギャップ、再発インシデント、プロセス上の非効率を特定し、プロセス、テクノロジー、サービス全体の改善を推進します。  改善活動をリードし、Root Cause Analysis（RCA）およびProblem Managementの実践を活用して、運用品質、サービス品質、ユーザー体験を向上。    パフォーマンス管理およびレポーティング（10%）   運用KPI、サービストレンド、パフォーマンス指標を追跡・分析し、定期レポートおよび随時レポートを通じてITリーダーシップへのレポート。     マネジメント業務    フィールドサービステームのメンバーをリード、コーチング、育成し、運用およびビジネス目標の達成を支援。  パフォーマンス管理、目標設定、コーチング、キャリア開発活動を実施。  会社方針および適用される法令に従い、管理監督を担う。 Haemme nyt Istekille      ASIAKASPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ Länsi-Suomen alueelle      Haluatko rakentaa asiakkaan menestystä ja erinomaista asiakaskokemusta? Vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti nimettyjen vastuualueittesi asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta ja asiakastyön toteutumisesta yhteistyönhallintamalliin perustuen. Ymmärrät ja kartoitat asiakkaan tarpeita sekä johdatat ne tavoitteellisesti läpi myyntiprosessin. Välität asiakkaan tarpeet ja odotukset sisäisille sidosryhmille, jotta pystymme tarjoamaan asiakaslähtöisiä ratkaisuja. Työskennellessäsi meillä pysyt alan kehityksen kärjessä ja saat itsellesi vakavaraisen sekä luotettavan työnantajan.   Jatkuvasti kehittyvä työympäristö  - Eteenpäin meneminen on meille tärkeää ja siksi kehitysaskeleita otetaan sitä mukaan, kun kehitettävää löydetään. Avulias ja ammattitaitoinen työtiimi  - Ketään ei jätetä yksin, vaan yhdessä tekemällä päästään parhaaseen mahdolliseen lopputulemaan.
