title: Client Success Associate - Dutch Speaking
description: Job Description    About the Role   The Client Success team follows a Client for Life Philosophy, and individuals in this role ensure that every Gartner client receives  value far exceeding their investment. Associates seek to understand and surface client’s business priorities, breakdown  challenges, and identify the most effective ways to support the client in making the right decisions for their business. They are  responsible for onboarding clients, proving the concept of Gartner services, and stimulating client engagement of products that are  used by large client teams.   What You Will Do     Partner with clients ranging from senior C-levels to more junior client professions in IT, HR, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Sales practices to ensure they are successful in the use of their Gartner subscription.  Deliver value to decision makers and drive Gartner growth by working as part of a service team where responsibilities can include: Introducing Gartner services and capabilities to prospective & new clients, account management or connecting clients with the Gartner expert community.  Identify client priorities and understand how to align Gartner's resources to provide best in class service that enables clients to achieve their priorities and maximize the return of investment on their Gartner memberships.  Collaborate with internal Gartner stakeholders to drive service delivery & business results, share best practices and design innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.  Leverage insights & metrics to drive continuous client engagement, satisfaction, retention and growth.     What You Will Need     Bachelors degree is preferred along with 6+ months relevant professional and/or internship experience.  Proven track record of success fueled by a passion for delighting clients  Strong communication, collaboration, prioritization, critical thinking, and influencing skills  Ability to use Dutch (Reading, Writing and Speaking) at a Business or Native level     Who Are We?   At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.  Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.  Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.   What Makes Gartner a Great Place to Work?   Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

title: Entry level Customer Success Manager (€30-€60k salary + commission)
description: We’re looking for entry level graduates, non-graduates and career changers as Tangent’s network grows globally across London, Barcelona, Berlin, Amsterdam and more. The starting salary is €30-€60k + commission.       What is Tangent      Tangent has created a new way to apply for jobs where industry expert mentors already working in the best companies provide free mentoring and support through the application process. On Tangent jobseekers sign-up and then connect with mentors for help with their CV, applications, industry advice and even support with salary negotiations. In today’s job market it’s almost impossible to get hired without the help of a mentor, they’ve been through the process in their career and want to give back by volunteering.     Tangent is a social impact platform built to help socially diverse backgrounds break into tech. Only 9% of tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds, despite them making up 39% of the total population! That's worse than law, consulting and banking! We’re on a mission to change this and we need your help!     No previous experience or a degree is required, just a passion for the mission - helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor      What you’ll do:        Client Onboarding:  Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and successful introduction to Tangent's services.   Relationship Management:  Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients, acting as their trusted advisor.   Understanding Client Needs:  Proactively understand your clients' business objectives, challenges, and desired outcomes.   Value Demonstration:  Demonstrate the value of Tangent's services by providing regular updates, insights, and best practice recommendations.   Adoption and Engagement:  Drive product adoption and engagement through training, support, and proactive communication.   Problem Solving:  Identify and resolve client issues promptly and effectively, escalating where necessary.   Retention and Growth:  Work to reduce churn and identify opportunities to expand client accounts.   Feedback Collection:  Gather client feedback and share insights with the product and development teams to improve our services.   Advocacy:  Encourage clients to become advocates for Tangent through testimonials, case studies, and referrals.   Performance Tracking:  Monitor client health metrics and proactively address any potential issues to ensure success.   Reporting:  Prepare and deliver regular client reports, highlighting key achievements and areas for improvement.       Why Join Tangent?        Competitive Salary and Commission:  Earn a competitive base salary plus uncapped commission based on performance. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package.   Make a Real Impact:  You'll be directly contributing to our mission of helping jobseekers get hired with the help of a mentor   Career Growth:  We're a rapidly growing company with plenty of opportunitie

title: Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö (määräaikainen perhevapaan sijaisuus)
description: Rakennamme yhdessä tulevaisuuden Fenniaa asiakasarvo edellä, jotta asiakkaamme, omistajamme, voivat yrittää ja elää. Visiomme on olla vetovoimaisin, vastuullinen toimija. Neljä arvoamme, reilu, vastuullisesti rohkea, kehittyvä ja yhdessä, ohjaavat sitä, miten saavutamme tavoitteemme.  Fenniassa työskentelee rohkeita edistäjiä eri aloilta, devaajista asiakaspalvelun rautaisiin ammattilaisiin. Jos olet vastuullisesti rohkea ja reilu tiimipelaaja, joka haluaa kehittää asioita yhdessä, voisit sopia joukkoomme. Lue tarkempi tehtävän kuvaus alta ja ryhdy toimeen.  Haemme asiakaskokemuspäällikköä määräaikaiseen perhevapaan sijaisuuteen Fennian Henkilöasiakasliiketoiminnan Asiakasymmärrys-tiimiin. Toivomme, että pääset perehtymään tehtävään jo joulukuussa ja tarttumaan toimeen tammikuussa. Työsuhteen kesto sijaisuuden tarpeen mukaisesti (arvio noin 12kk).  Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Fennia ymmärtää asiakkaidensa tarpeita, odotuksia, käyttäytymistä ja kokemuksia sekä kehittää palveluitaan tämän tiedon pohjalta.  Tehtävässä tuotat asiakas- ja asiakaskokemusymmärrystä henkilöasiakasliiketoiminnan johtamisen ja kehittämisen tueksi. Hyödynnät monipuolisesti asiakasymmärrystä, asiakaskokemusdataa, tutkimuksia sekä liiketoimintadataa tunnistaaksesi asiakkaiden tarpeisiin liittyviä ilmiöitä, kehityskohteita ja kasvumahdollisuuksia. Definire e monitorare KPI di qualità, condurre review e retrospettive, promuovere il miglioramento continuo dei processi.  Presidiare la gestione dei rischi e la conformità a procedure interne e requisiti del cliente.  Misurare la soddisfazione (survey, review periodiche, KPI condivisi) e trasformare i feedback in piani d'azione concreti. title: RevOps Manager
description:
Headquarters:  United States
      URL:   https://www.clickguard.com/ 
 

  We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next.  
  Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers.  
  Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency.  
   What You'll Own   
 
  HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored  
  The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses  
  Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal  
  AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced.  
 
  The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery.

Role: Service Delivery Manager    Key Responsibilities    Lead and manage end-to-end project delivery, including implementation, development, deployment and maintenance.  Establish and maintain effective project governance and delivery processes.  Manage project resources, schedules, budgets, risks and deliverables.  Coordinate with MOH stakeholders, technical teams, business analysts and third-party vendors.  Monitor project progress and ensure delivery meets agreed timelines and quality standards. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description: Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.   Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.  But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a  BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year , reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.  Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.   What We Offer     Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.  Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.  Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.  Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.     Position Summary   Reporting to the Director, Customer Success, the Strategic Customer Success Manager plays a pivotal role in maintaining and growing customer health and revenue by aligning customer needs, product capabilities, and evolving use cases. This position combines entrepreneurial drive, deep technical aptitude, and collaborative leadership with the ability to influence senior leaders and work across high-profile customers in Payments, Marketpl

title: Customer Success Manager
description: D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.  New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.  D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.  D2L has had a singular mission for 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.  Every application we receive is personally reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team - yes, a real person looks at your resume! While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.   Job Summary   As a Customer Success Manager, you lead as a strategic partner, with customers to drive measurable outcomes, operational efficiency, and long-term growth through the effective use of D2L’s Brightspace platform. You bring together deep product expertise, industry insight, and consultative capability to design, execute, and manage customer success plans that align platform capabilities with institutional and business goals.   Success in this role is measured by the outcomes customers achieve through effective adoption, the value they realize, and your ability to influence sustained success aligned to their strategic and business objectives.    Major Responsibilities     Lead as a strategic partner with customers to align their objectives with actionable success plans that drive efficiency, growth, and measurable outcomes through Brightspace adoption.    Design, own, and continuously evolve customer success and adoption plans, ensuring strong alignment between customer goals, industry best practices, and the capabilities of the Brightspace platform.    Drive value realization by applying deep knowledge of Brightspace, the education technology landscape, and customer workflows to identify opportunities for optimization, innovation, and improved outcomes.    Lead targeted adoption initiatives by identifying gaps in product usage and working closely with key customer stakeholders to advance platform maturity and effectiveness.    Proactively assess customer health, identify risk, and influence corrective actions that increase engagement, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term success.    Drive customer communication and engagement strategies

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work.  We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.   What We Are Looking For   Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven  Enterprise   Customer Success Manager  to join our EMEA team.   What You Will Be Doing   As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis.  Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.   You Will Be Responsible For     Design a success plan for a Book of Business of strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals  You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets  Act as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs  Lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations  Monitor record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc  Develop and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)  Identify potential customer references and assist with development of customer case studies  Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services  In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program

title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description: The global population is aging, and the need for home care is growing each year. Unfortunately, at a time when care is needed more than ever, the home care industry is facing a crisis – a shortage of care workers.  At Caribou, we're on a mission to solve the caregiver crisis. When caregivers feel valued, recognized, and financially secure, they stay longer, deliver better care, and strengthen our communities.  Caribou is building the engagement infrastructure for the home care workforce and the agentic layer for home care operations. Our platform interfaces with office staff and front-line caregivers to facilitate meaningful recognition, stronger relationships, and operational efficiency.  Caribou was recently recognized as one of Canada's fastest-growing companies by both The Globe and Mail (#4 in technology) and Deloitte's Technology Fast 50™ – and we're just getting started! Join us as we transform how care organizations recognize and retain the people who make care possible.    The Opportunity    We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to lead strategic enterprise customer accounts. This opportunity is for a compassionate problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments and is looking to make a meaningful impact with the largest home care companies in North America.  Customer Success at Caribou combines consulting, project and relationship management, analytics, data storytelling, and applying behavioral psychology principles to caregiver engagement program design. This role will report to the Head of Enterprise Customer Success. Success in this role will be defined by your ability to drive measurable outcomes for your customers and identify and manage risk to value-attainment. You'll collaborate with executive and senior-level stakeholders and influence product enhancements to maximize value to enterprise home care companies.   What You Will Be Doing     Owning customer performance end-to-end, from implementation through renewals and scale-ups, for enterprise agencies and strategic accounts  Leading and coordinating launches of new customers across North America  Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify new ways to solve customer issues and unlock maximum value  Supporting home care agencies with innovative strategies, best practices, and data analysis  Turning ambiguity into repeatable systems as we scale (building playbooks, mapping the customer journey, etc.)   Working cross-functionally with product, operations, integrations, and other teams on strategic projects or new growth opportunities     About You     2+ years of working with customers or managing relationships (bonus for consulting, high-growth startups, or home/healthcare experience)  High integrity and reliability – you do what you say you're going to do, and your customers and teammates know it  Growth mindset and a hunger for feedback – you grow fast because you're actively looking for opportunities for professional development and getting b

title: Client Success Manager
description: Vacature | Client Success Manager – Worldmeetings      Sterke klantrelaties ontstaan niet vanzelf. Ze vragen om aandacht, inzicht en de ambitie om continu waarde toe te voegen. Weet jij als geen ander hoe je klanten aan je bindt en samenwerkingen naar een hoger niveau tilt? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.     Bij Worldmeetings ondersteunen we organisaties bij het efficiënt organiseren en boeken van zakelijke bijeenkomsten, vergaderingen en overnachtingen. Daarnaast organiseren we evenementen die aansluiten bij de wensen en doelstellingen van onze klanten. Met een sterke focus op service, kwaliteit en langdurige partnerships maken wij dagelijks het verschil voor onze klanten.     Om onze klantrelaties verder te versterken, zoeken wij een gedreven  Client Success Manager.       Jouw rol   Als Client Success Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, onderhouden en versterken van duurzame relaties met onze zakelijke klanten. Je begrijpt hun behoeften, denkt strategisch mee en vertaalt kansen naar concrete verbeteringen in onze dienstverlening. Je bent niet alleen een aanspreekpunt, maar vooral een waardevolle sparringpartner die bijdraagt aan klanttevredenheid, klantbehoud en groei.      Wat ga je doen?   - Beheren en uitbouwen van een portefeuille zakelijke klanten.  - Opbouwen van sterke relaties met belangrijke stakeholders.  - Signaleren van commerciële kansen en mogelijkheden om samenwerkingen te verdiepen.  - Proactief adviseren over het optimaal benutten van onze dienstverlening.  - Monitoren van klanttevredenheid, prestaties en verbeterkansen.  - Samenwerken met interne afdelingen om de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.      Wie zoeken wij?   Wij zoeken een professional die klantgerichtheid combineert met commercieel inzicht en een proactieve instelling.     - Je hebt ervaring in accountmanagement, customer success of relatiebeheer.  - Je communiceert overtuigend en schakelt gemakkelijk op verschillende niveaus.  - Je bent analytisch, resultaatgericht en denkt in oplossingen.  - Je herkent commerciële kansen en weet deze om te zetten in concrete acties.  - Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en houdt overzicht.  - Je hebt affiniteit met zakelijke dienstverlening, hospitality, evenementen en technologie.      Wat maakt werken bij Worldmeetings interessant?   Bij Worldmeetings krijg je de kans om een directe bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze klantrelaties en dienstverlening.     Je werkt in een professionele, ondernemende omgeving waarin samenwerking, kwaliteit en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. Er is ruimte voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en het realiseren van zichtbare resultaten.      Bouw jij met ons mee aan succesvolle klantrelaties?      Dan komen we graag met je in contact.     Solliciteer via msnoek@worldmeetings.nl en ontdek wat jij voor Worldmeetings kunt betekenen.    #Worldmeetings #Vacature #ClientSuccessManager #CustomerSuccess #Accountmanagement #Relatiebeh

title: Operationeel Manager Adviescentrum
description: Weet jij hoe je collega's motiveert, ontwikkelt en samen sterke resultaten behaalt? Als Operationeel Manager Adviescentrum bij Univé Oost-Nederland geef je richting aan jouw team en verbeter je de dienstverlening aan onze leden. We zoeken bij voorkeur iemand die al leidinggevende ervaring meebrengt en toe is aan een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief.      Wat ga je doen?   Als Operationeel Manager Adviescentrum geef je leiding aan een team van 16 tot 25 commercieel adviseurs. Je zorgt voor een goede balans tussen werkplezier, klantbediening en commerciële resultaten. Je vertaalt de plannen van het Adviescentrum naar duidelijke doelen en concrete acties voor jouw team.     Dit zijn jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:    Leidinggeven en coachen:  je ondersteunt medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling, voert goede gesprekken en creëert een open en vitale werkomgeving waarin vertrouwen, feedback en eigenaarschap centraal staan.   Resultaten realiseren:  je stuurt op klantgerichtheid, commerciële prestaties, kwaliteit en efficiëntie en maakt samen met je team afspraken over concrete verbeteringen.   Plannen en organiseren:  je bewaakt de personeelsbezetting en continuïteit van je team en stemt waar nodig af met WFM & Traffic over capaciteit en bereikbaarheid.   Verbeteringen doorvoeren:  je herkent kansen in klantcontactprocessen, gebruikt data om keuzes te onderbouwen en neemt je team mee in veranderingen en digitalisering.   Kwaliteit en risico’s beheersen:  je zorgt voor een zorgvuldige werkwijze, houdt oog voor relevante wet- en regelgeving en stimuleert medewerkers om processen continu te verbeteren.       Wat bieden wij?   Je krijgt een betekenisvolle leidinggevende functie met veel ruimte om mensen te ontwikkelen, initiatief te nemen en samen resultaten neer te zetten. Daar horen goede arbeidsvoorwaarden bij:    Salaris & arbeidsvoorwaarden : een salaris dat past bij jouw opleiding, ervaring en competenties, met een salaris vanaf €3.765 tot € 5.228 euro bruto per maand (o.b.v. 38 uur per week). title: Front Office Manager - Nights
description: At Adare Manor, our vision is 'Beyond Everything' - a commitment to creating magical, unforgettable experiences for our guests and team alike. As a globally celebrated luxury resort, we are proud to hold the prestigious Forbes Five-Star rating and Michelin's highest distinction - Three Keys. From Michelin-starred dining to world-class golf, including hosting the 2027 Ryder Cup, Adare Manor is a place where excellence thrives. If you share our passion for delivering extraordinary experiences, we would love to welcome you to our award-winning team.  As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for a Night Manager to join Adare Manor on a permanent, full-time contract, leading our overnight team and ensuring a seamless guest experience throughout the night.   Duties And Responsibilities     Lead the overnight Front Office and Housekeeping teams, ensuring that all work meets Adare Manor's service standards, policies and procedures.  Oversee hotel operations during the night shift, maintaining guest satisfaction, safety and a professional, welcoming environment.  Conduct nightly team briefings to communicate priorities and allocate responsibilities.  Keep the overnight team informed of hotel activities, group and VIP arrivals, returning guests and special requests.  Check that guest accommodation is prepared and special requests are fulfilled; welcome arriving guests and arrange escorts to their accommodation where appropriate.  Respond to guest enquiries and concerns promptly, professionally and discreetly, maintaining exceptional service throughout the night.  Coordinate Front Office activities with other departments to ensure assigned tasks are completed and overnight operations run smoothly.  Ensure public areas remain clean, tidy and welcoming throughout the night. Ensure the daily night audit is completed accurately and on time.  Report suspicious activity and hazardous conditions promptly to Security and/or the Front Office Manager, following hotel procedures.     About You     Previous experience in night management or a supervisory Front Office role within a high-quality hotel or luxury hospitality environment.  Confidence overseeing overnight hotel operations, coordinating departments and maintaining exceptional standards of guest service.  A sound understanding of night audit procedures, strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, timely reporting.  Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and remain calm under pressure during the night shift.  A guest-focused approach, with the confidence to manage arrivals, special requests and guest concerns professionally and discreetly.  Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to brief, coach and support the overnight team.  A proactive, hands-on approach, sound judgement and th

title: Client Account Manager
description: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.  As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.   Job Description   The Client Account Manager is the strategic face of Payment Services to the client, representing multiple business channels. They are responsible for the overall management of a book of accounts, including maintenance, growth, increased profitability, strategic direction, overall client satisfaction, and contract renewals. Consults with clients through data analysis, industry education, presentation of performance results and recommending action to improve performance. Is the escalation point for both internal and external client issues.   What You’ll Do:    Manage and Grow Client Relationships     Own and manage a portfolio of client accounts, ensuring strong engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction  Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to expand services and increase profitability  Serve as a trusted advisor, aligning Payment Services solutions to client business objectives       Deliver Strategic Insights     Analyze client performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations  Present performance results and strategic recommendations in a clear, client-focused manner  Educate clients on industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities within payments      Account Strategy & Renewals     Develop and execute account strategies that support long-term client success  Manage contract renewals and support negotiation efforts to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes       Basic Qualifications      Associate's degree, or equivalent work experience   Typically two or more years of client management experience in payments industry      Preferred Skills/Experience      Strong contract negotiation, account management and project management skills   Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills   Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects

description: Global Account Manager - HVAC/Cooling     Ireland     €90,000 - €110,000 + Bonus + 30 Days Holiday + Benefits Package       An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Global Pharma Key Account Manager to join a leading international provider of high-performance HVAC, cooling, clean-air and controlled-environment solutions. title: Senior OTC Sales Trader
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced OTC Sales Trader to join our OTC Trading team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and executing large-scale cryptocurrency trades for institutional and high-net-worth clients, providing exceptional client service, and driving business growth through strategic sales initiatives.

What You'll Do:

  • Execute OTC cryptocurrency trades on behalf of institutional clients, high-net-worth individuals, and partners with a focus on accuracy, speed, and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients to understand their trading needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with the trading desk, risk management, and compliance teams to ensure smooth trade execution and adherence to regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor market trends, liquidity, and pricing to provide clients with competitive and timely trade opportunities.
  • Identify new business opportunities and contribute to the growth of the OTC trading desk.
  • Prepare and present regular reports on trading activity, client feedback, and market insights to senior management.
  • Ensure all trades comply with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
  • Provide excellent client support and resolve any trade-related issues promptly.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Proven experience (8+ years) in OTC trading, sales trading, or institutional sales within the cryptocurrency or traditional financial markets in MENA.
  • Strong understanding of cryptocurrency markets, blockchain technology, and digital asset trading.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in trading platforms and tools; experience with OTC trading desks is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems.   • Share actionable market feedback with sales and product leadership to inform pricing, packaging, measurement, and ad experiences while protecting the learner experience.
  • Operate with speed and rigor in a startup‑like environment, building repeatable sales

title: Sales Development Representative
description:

There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

  The Role:  We are hiring a Marketing Specialist to work across both client and Forward Push marketing priorities, taking approved strategy, content, and direction and turning it into accurate, polished work that is executed correctly. That includes creating brand and web assets from approved direction. 
 This is a hands-on, proactive role. Our AI agents and automations handle more of the repetitive work every month, so this role is not about copying and pasting or scheduling posts. title: Database Engineering Intern
description:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.

Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible

Tasks

  • Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled.

  • Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed.

  • Improve our data models: reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

  • Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application.

  • Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

  • Review our database access policies.

Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

  • Comfortable in SQL: joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

  • You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

  • PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

  • Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

title: Head of Research & Editorial

About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

Why this role

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

  • Set the research agenda

  • Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

  • Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

  • Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

  • Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulat

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once:

title: ML Compiler & System
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

 

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Het Customer Succes team is verantwoordelijk voor het beheren en het uitbouwen van het huidige klantportfolio, dat gebruik maakt van onze verzuimsoftware. Samen met vier Customer Success Managers help je bestaande klanten om efficiënter en effectiever gebruik te maken van onze softwareoplossing. Als CSM heb je twee belangrijke doelstellingen waar we actief op sturen: klantwaarde en klanttevredenheid. Je hebt jouw eigen klanten waarmee je vooral op tactisch en strategisch niveau een langdurige klantrelatie opbouwt. Jij bent de “trusted advisor” voor de beslissers bij de klant en samen kijken we continue naar extra mogelijkheden en kansen, en helpt jij samen met alle collega’s de klanten het optimale uit de software te halen.      Functieomschrijving   Als Customer Success Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onboarden van nieuwe klanten, ondersteund door een projectteam. Je onderhoudt relaties met klanten op verschillende niveaus binnen hun organisatie, met de focus op klanttevredenheid, -behoud en groei van de portefeuille. Je zorgt voor omzetgroei door upsell/cross-sell en analyseert zowel klantdoelstellingen als die van je eigen organisatie om deze te bereiken.     Je fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en wijst hen op beschikbare resources, zoals kennisbanken, trainingen en handleidingen. Daarnaast monitor je de opvolging van taken, ondersteund door de binnendienst, en analyseer je klantfeedback om producten en klanttevredenheid te verbeteren. Je onderhoudt nauw contact met klanten en interne opdrachtverantwoordelijken, zoals de Lead of Project Manager.     Je bent alert op ontwikkelingen bij klanten die kunnen leiden tot het reduceren of beëindigen van de dienstverlening en onderneemt initiatieven om klanttevredenheid te verbeteren waar nodig. Je houdt jezelf op de hoogte van relevante trends, ontwikkelingen in de markt, productkennis en processen.     Tot slot bewaak je, met ondersteuning van de binnendienst, de naleving van gemaakte afspraken, zoals vastgelegd in DAP, SLA's, werkopdrachten en bijbehorende KPI's. Je stelt DAP's op, waarbij klantbehoeften vertaald worden naar concrete afspraken, en rapporteert over prestaties aan in- en externe stakeholders.      Over jou    HBO werk en denkniveau (bij voorkeur Bedrijfskundig, IT, Commerciële Economie);  Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Account Manager, SLA en/of Delivery Manager, Consultant of Project Manager;  Je hebt kennis van (markt- en klant)ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied van bedrijfsgezondheid en sociale zekerheid;  Je hebt kennis van projectmanagement en IT-beheer methodieken;  Je bent klantgericht;  Je beschikt over commercieel inzicht;  Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;  Je bent in staat om vanuit een helikopter view te werken;  Je legt makkelijk contact en is in staat relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden.      Deze eisen en vaardigheden geven een richting van het profiel dat wij zoeken

Du kommer til at indgå i et stærkt lederfællesskab på tværs af virksomheden, hvor vi sammen tager ansvar for helheden.         Om Provas   Provas er Haderslev Kommunes forsyningsselskab, der leverer drikkevand og håndterer spildevand, affald og genbrug for kommunens 56.000 indbyggere. Indsatserne har stor betydning for fremtidige generationer ved at sikre et bæredygtig vandkredsløb og genbrug af ressourcer.     Provas er en moderne virksomhed med godt 80 ansatte. Omkring halvdelen arbejder i den fysiske drift, og resten arbejder overvejende på kontoret. Der er et fladt hierarki, så i dagligdagen er topledelse ikke et tydeligt begreb. Ledelsesstilen hos Provas er inddragende og støttende, og der er en tydelig involvering af medarbejderne, så alle udvikler sig med opgaverne og i fællesskab finder de bedste løsninger.      I Provas arbejdes der både med hovedet og med hjertet. Derfor lægges der stor vægt på, at medarbejderne har talent for at lytte, samarbejde og anerkende et godt argument.         Dit nye job er en nøglerolle …   Som leder af vores genbrugs

title: Team Lead
description: Haemme Mikkelin Motonet-tavarataloon   Team Leadia   Haemme tiimiin myynnillistä ja esihenkilötyöstä innostuvaa Team Leadia.Team Leadina toimit osana tavaratalon arkea ja vastaat omalta osaltasi myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja päivittäisten toimintojen sujuvuudesta. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy jo aikaisempaa esihenkilökokemusta, kaupallista ajattelua ja halua saada tiimi onnistumaan.  🤝 Työsuhde on kokoaikainen 37,5h/vko ja vakituinen  👍 Työn luonteen vuoksi hakijoilta edellytetään 18 vuoden ikää  💰 Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan. Palkka määräytyy tehtävään valittavan henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.  Työssäsi johdat tiimiäsi valmentavalla otteella, tuet tiimiläisten osaamisen kehittymistä ja varmistat, että ketjuohjeistusten mukainen toiminta toteutuu arjessa. Tehtävässä vastaat keskeisistä operatiivisista kokonaisuuksista, kuten rahavirtojen ja palveluiden sujuvuudesta sekä tiimin osaamisen, toimintatapojen ja tekemisen kehittämisestä.  Team Lead osallistuu myös tavaratalon työhön kaikissa vuoroissa, ja tehtävään kuuluu joustavasti myös muita tavaratalon tehtäviä. Arjessa olet mukana asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityössä, toimit esimerkkinä tiimillesi ja huolehdit siitä, että tekemisessä näkyvät hyvä palveluasenne, aktiivinen myynti ja halu tehdä kauppaa.  Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sytyt myynnistä, asiakaskohtaamisista ja tiimin valmentamisesta. Toivomme, että sinulta löytyy kaupallista nälkää, myynnillistä pilkettä silmäkulmassa ja aitoa halua kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi tekemistä. Työskennellessäsi meillä pysyt alan kehityksen kärjessä ja saat itsellesi vakavaraisen sekä luotettavan työnantajan.   Jatkuvasti kehittyvä työympäristö  - Eteenpäin meneminen on meille tärkeää ja siksi kehitysaskeleita otetaan sitä mukaan, kun kehitettävää löydetään. Uudistuminen on toimintamme pohja ja se on viety arvoihimme saakka.   Mahdollisuus kehittää itseäsi  - Työssä kehittyminen on meillä ehdoton kunnia-asia! Jokainen meillä saa edellytykset kehittyä omassa työssään niin sisäisten kuin ulkoistenkin koulutusten parissa. Erityisesti panostamme lähijohtamiseen, johon koulutamme ja opastamme henkilöstöä mm. omien esihenkilö- ja päällikkövalmennusten kautta

title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö, 37.5h/vko, JYSK Seppälä
description: Työpaikan kuvaus   Koetko motivoituvasi esihenkilövastuusta, mutta sinulla ei ole vielä kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä?  Meillä ratkaisee asenne ja tavoitteellisuus oppia uutta sekä tehdä tulosta. Meillä apulaismyymäläpäälliköt saavat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden kasvaa. Meillä voit luoda uraa, ja tavoitella tulevaisuudessa omaa myymälää. Jos olet valmiina tarttumaan haasteisiin, tämä voi olla juuri sinun paikkasi.  Tutustu ja lue lisää apulaismyymäläpäällikön työstä JYSKissä.   APULAISMYYMÄLÄPÄÄLLIKÖN TYÖ JYSKISSÄ     Olet vastuussa myymälän myynnillisestä johtamisesta, B2B-myynnistä ja koulutat tiimiä jatkuvasti eri JYSK konseptien tiimoilta.   Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtäsi: meillä jokaisella on selkeä suunta ja halu ylittää odotukset.   Toimit tiiviisti myymäläpäällikön työparina, ja saat vastuullisesi myös esihenkilövastuita ja –tehtäviä.   Toimit hyvänä esimerkkinä koko tiimille, priorisoit ja valtuutat viikoittaisia työtehtäviä tiimin kesken, tuet työvuorosuunnittelussa, huolehdit kampanjavaihdoista, tiimin tiedottamisesta, seuraat tunnuslukuja ja teet tarvittavia toimia sekä pidät huolta että myymälä on aina kaupallinen ja valmiina asiakkaita varten.   Viikoittaisiin tehtäviisi kuuluu myös aktiivinen palautteenantaminen tiimille auttaen heitä onnistumaan työssään.   Työ vaatii hyvää peruskuntoa, mutta saat käyttöösi parhaat työvälineet ja tiimin tuen.   Monipuolisuutta – myymälä, varasto, kampanjat… tylsyys ei kuulu sanavarastoomme.      MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA     Sinulla on motivaatiota tehdä töitä esihenkilönä ja johtaa tiimiä tuloksiin omalla esimerkilläsi.   Kokemus ja näytöt esimerkiksi vuorovastaavan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä.   Olet myyntihenkinen, ja tuloksellisuus sekä tavoitteiden ylittäminen ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita työssäsi. Haluat myös myydä ja menestyä joka työvuorossa.   Tunnet muiden kouluttamisen, perehdyttämisen ja opastamisen osaksi omia vahvuuksiasi.   Siedät keskeneräisyyttä, koska tekemistä on paljon ja kaikkea ei aina voi saada valmiiksi kerralla.   Olet parhaimmillasi kiireessä ja nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä. Tykkäät nopeatempoisesta työtahdista ja yllättävistäkin työtehtävistä kesken työvuoron.   Olet aloitteellinen ja itsenäisesti toimeentarttuva, sekä saat energiaa tiimityöstä ja omien tavoitteidesi ylittämisestä.   Olet joustava sekä tehtävien että työtuntien ja työaikojen suhteen. Töitä tehdään vaihtelevasti eri vuoroissa aamulla, illalla kuin viikonloppuisinkin.      MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE     Palkkaus kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.   Peruspalkan ja lisien lisäksi apulaismyymäläpäälliköillä on oma vuosittain määriteltävä bonusohjelma  Kattavalla perehdytysohjelmalla sekä myymäläpäällikön tuella opit nopeasti työn, voit näyttää taitosi sekä kasvaa ja kehittyä tulevaisuudessa myymäläpäällikön tehtäviin.   Työvuorosuunnittelumme tukee palautumista ja työssäjaksamista.   Meillä on turvallinen työympäristö, jossa työn fyysisyyttä on auttamassa erilaisia apuvälineitä, ja aktiiv

title: Team Lead Retail & Customer Support (m/w/d), 80-100%
description: Stromer lebt Swissness, Begeisterung und Partnerschaft.      Die myStromer AG entwickelt seit 2009 international ausgezeichnete Speed Pedelecs, die mit herausragender Leistung, Konnektivität und Design den urbanen Verkehr neu definieren. Unser Ziel: Die besten S-Pedelecs zu entwickeln und Menschen zu begeistern, sie täglich zu benutzen. Dafür bündeln wir an unserem Stromer Campus in Oberwangen alle Kompetenzen unter einem Dach – von der Entwicklung, über die Montage, das Marketing, bis zum Vertrieb. Denn mit jeder einzelnen Idee gestalten wir gemeinsam die Mobilität von morgen.     Seit 2022 gehört auch die Marke Desiknio zum Portfolio der myStromer AG. Unsere Marken Stromer und Desiknio verbindet eine hohe Innovationskraft, vollintegriertes Design, führende Technologie sowie erstklassige Qualität. Zusammen verfolgen wir den Anspruch, die Zukunft der Mobilität mit mehr Fahrfreude, Effizienz und Lebensqualität zu gestalten. Gleichzeitig ist Desiknio die ideale Ergänzung für das Stromer Produktportfolio. Die Premium-E-Bikes von Desiknio, die in Spanien entworfen und in Europa handgefertigt werden, sind mit einer Unterstützung bis 25 km/h perfekt für den innerstädtischen Verkehr und kürzere Strecken geeignet.     An unserem Hauptsitz in Oberwangen suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, lösungsorientierte und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit als      Team Lead Retail & Customer Support (m/w/d), 80-100%      Als Team Lead Retail & Customer Support bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Retail- und Customer-Support-Organisation in der DACH-Region, Frankreich sowie bei Bedarf in weiteren Märkten. Du stellst einen effizienten, qualitativ hochwertigen und kundenorientierten Support für Kunden und Handelspartner sicher und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung einer skalierbaren internationalen Supportorganisation bei.     Dabei verbindest du operative Führung, technische Expertise und moderne Technologien wie KI, Automatisierung und Self-Service-Lösungen, um unseren Fachhandelspartnern und Kundinnen sowie Kunden einen erstklassigen Service zu bieten. Du sorgst dafür, dass Probleme schnell gelöst, Prozesse kontinuierlich verbessert und wertvolle Erkenntnisse für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte gewonnen werden.       Deine Aufgaben    Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung des Retail & Customer Support Teams  Sicherstellung eines effizienten und qualitativ hochwertigen Support-Tagesgeschäfts  Unterstützung des Teams bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen und Eskalationen  Direkte Betreuung von Handelspartnern sowie Aufbau langfristiger Partnerschaften  Einführung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Supportprozessen, Automatisierungen und KI-Lösungen  Analyse relevanter Support-Kennzahlen und Ableitung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen  Planung und Durchführung von Supportkampagnen, Produktupdates und Rückrufaktionen  Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Quality, Product Manage

title: 푸드CX팀장
description: 구분: 경력(7년이상)       [조직소개]     CX센터는 우아한형제들의 모든 서비스에 대한 CX(Customer Experience) 정책을 직접 설계하고, 운영 구조 전반을 주도적으로 개선합니다. VOC와 데이터를 바탕으로 서비스 구조를 바꾸는 일을 합니다.    푸드CX팀은 배달의민족 푸드 서비스를 이용하는 고객·사장님·라이더의 상담 경험을 책임지는 조직입니다. 콜·채팅·AI 상담 채널을 운영하고, 민원이 생기는 원인을 찾아 서비스와 정책을 바꾸는 일까지 함께 합니다. 같은 문의가 다시 생기지 않는 구조를 만드는 것이 팀의 목표입니다.    이 포지션은 눈앞의 문제를 해결하는 데서 멈추지 않고, 근본적인 개선과 구조 설계로 고객 경험과 운영 효율을 함께 끌어올립니다.           [업무내용]     1. 문의량 자체를 줄이는 운영 환경·정책·시스템 개선 과제 주도      - VOC·문의 유형·리드타임 분석을 통한 인입 구조 문제 발굴, 반복·오류 문의 원인 분류 및 개선 우선순위 설정      - 개선 아이템별 임팩트 정의·분석 및 근거 기반 개선안 유관 부서 제안      - 상담 프로세스·어드민 기능·정책 개선을 통한 불필요한 문의 유입 차단, FAQ·챗봇·AI 상담 등 고객 자가 해결 경험 향상      - 개선 과제 커뮤니케이션·실행 리딩, 배포 이후 효과 검증 및 후속 과제 연계    2. CX프로덕트실과 협업한 운영 문제의 제품·정책 반영      - 데이터로 발견한 문제의 화면 플로우·기능 정의서 등 프로덕트 조직이 이해할 수 있는 형태로의 구체화      - 상담 시스템 전환·고도화, AI 상담 확대, IVR(자동응답) 개편 과정의 운영 요구사항 정의·반영 및 전환 시점 운영 리스크 사전 점검    3. 중대 이슈 선제 대응 체계 수립      - 여러 주체가 얽힌 복합 이슈 대응 및 재발 방지를 위한 운영 체계 재설계      - 리스크 조기 감지 방법 및 에스컬레이션 경로 설계·운영      - 신규 유형 민원 대응 기준 수립·문서화를 통한 구성원 간 판단 기준 일원화    4. 유관 조직 협업을 통한 과제 실행력 확보      - 사업·정책·프로덕트·딜리버리 등 유관 조직과의 협업 및 공감대 기반 과제 완수      - 운영 성과 정기 리뷰 및 리더십 커뮤니케이션, 지표 변동 시 문의 유형 구성 변화와 실제 성과 변화를 구분한 원인 설명    5. 팀 빌딩 및 구성원 육성      - 구성원 코칭·성과 관리 및 팀 내 우선순위 정렬      - 정답 제시보다 판단 기준과 맥락 제공을 통한 구성원의 자율적 문제 해결 지원      - 차기 리더 후보 육성           [지원자격]     - CX·고객센터 운영 분야 7년 이상 경력    - 고객 여정·상담 흐름·인입 구조에 대한 깊은 이해    - 고객센터·상담 운영 조직 리딩 경험    - 운영 비효율을 데이터로 진단해 정량적 개선 성과를 만들고, 그 개선이 유지되도록 구조를 설계한 경험    - 복잡한 상황을 구조적으로 정리하고 명확하게 커뮤니케이션하는 역량           [우대사항]     - 푸드 또는 커머스 플랫폼 CX 경험    - 여러 플랫폼·서비스 병행 운영 또는 그에 준하는 복잡도의 운영 경험    - 100명 이상 규모 CX 조직에서 운영기획·서비스기획·VOC 개선 프로젝트를 주도한 경험    - 조직 개편·업무 이관 과정에서 운영을 안정적으로 유지한 경험    - 상담 시스템 또는 AI 상담 도입·운영 경험    - 2차 민원(에스컬레이션) 대응 경험    - 이해관계가 상충하는 다수 조직 간 조율을 통해 합의를 도출한 경험    - 제품·정책 조직과 협업해 운영 개선을 시스템·정책으로 정착시킨 경험    - 문제 정의부터 개선 실행, 효과 검증까지 완결한 개선 사이클을 문의량 감소 등 정량 성과로 연결한 경험

title: Afdelingschef til Kunder og Marked hos Midttrafik
description: Kan du komme hele vejen rundt om kundens rejseoplevelse?       Kunderne skal kunne regne med Midttrafik hver eneste dag. Som afdelingschef for Kunder og Marked i Midttrafik leder du fire velfungerende teams, følger den strategiske retning for en driftsfokuseret afdeling og sikrer, at kundens perspektiv har en stemme i vores beslutninger.      Midttrafik er et fælleskommunalt trafikselskab, ejet af 18 kommuner og Region Midtjylland. Vi sikrer kollektiv trafik, der hænger sammen i hele regionen. Hos os er visionen klar: Vores kundefokus skaber nem, attraktiv og bæredygtig mobilitet for alle passagerer. Og her kommer du så ind i billedet som afdelingschefen, der fortsat holder visionen og kunden i fokus.      Opgaven, du træder ind i   Kunderne møder hver dag Midttrafik i telefonen, på skærmene og ude på ruterne. Med Strategiplan 2025–2028 har afdelingen fået en klar retning: Kunderejsen skal være nem, tilgængelig og forståelig før, under og efter turen.     Som afdelingschef får du ansvaret for, at afdelingen lever op til den ambition – både i den daglige drift og i den videre udvikling. Du bliver også en del af et chefteam med direktør Lars Berg i spidsen, hvor du sammen med to chefkollegaer er med til at sætte retningen for hele Midttrafik.      Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at    lede afdelingen Kunder og Marked gennem tre teamledere og have direkte ledelse af Markedsføringsteamet på fire personer  omsætte Strategiplan 2025–2028 til konkrete handlingsplaner og prioriteter og følge op på, at afdelingen leverer på dem  sikre stabil drift og tydelig kommunikation til kunderne, også når driften bliver forstyrret  drive den digitale udvikling i afdelingen sammen med IT & Digitalisering, så kunderne oplever nemme og sammenhængende digitale løsninger  have ansvaret for afdelingens budget, business cases, projekter og leverandørkontrakter – og samarbejde tæt med dine to chefkollegaer om Midttrafiks samlede prioriteringer  være sparringspartner for direktøren, når organisationens vigtigste beslutninger skal træffes      Det er et forholdsvis ungt lederteam, der sætter pris på en chef, som giver sparring og plads, viser vejen og hjælper med at prioritere de mange vigtige opgaver. Du står i spidsen for en afdeling med høj faglighed, så der er plads til at fokusere på den langsigtede udvikling og ledelse.  Samtidig skal afdelingen udvikle sig i takt med kundernes behov og de digitale muligheder – med blik for, at faglighed og personlig kontakt fortsat gør en stor forskel for kunderne.      Velkommen i teamet   I rollen bliver du chef for Kunder og Marked, som består af fire teams:   Trafikservice  sørger blandt andet for hurtig og forståelig information til kunderne, når driften bliver forstyrret.   Kundeservice  svarer kunderne på telefon og skriftligt.   Billetkontrol  står for administrationen af udstedte kontrolafgifter.   Markedsføring  arbejder både for, at flere vælger den kollektive trafik, og for at profilere Midttrafiks produkter.     I

title: Customer Lifecycle Manager til Zederkof
location: Fredericia Municipality, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Er du typen, der ikke giver dig, før målet er nået? Tænker du i data og får energi af at drive salget på tal, systemer og et CRM, der er skruet rigtigt sammen? Og kan du samtidig gå forrest og løfte et salgsteam?       Så skal du læse videre!       Vi søger nemlig en Customer Lifecycle Manager til Zederkof, der som spillende træner kan drive pipelinen i salgsafdelingen og løfte både resultater og team.       Timer:  Fuldtid   Tiltrædelse:  Hurtigst muligt   Arbejdssted:  Fredericia      Hvis du kan genkende dette, så er det dig vi leder efter!    Du er vedholdende og konsekvent i jagten på dine mål. Når noget står i vejen, finder du en ny vej derhen, og du stopper ikke, bare fordi der kommer lidt modstand.  Du tager ofte ansvar som den første, fordi det giver dig energi. Du er pålidelig, og du overholder altid det, du har lovet.  Du er dirigenten, der fordeler opgaverne og holder trådene samlet. Du ved altid hvad status er i projekterne, og hvor langt alle er med opgaverne.  Selv når der er meget data, og den er kompleks, har du styr på tingene. Du finder den røde tråd i store mængder data, og du træffer hellere datadrevne beslutninger end at gå på mavefornemmelse.  Du ved, at tingene altid kan gøres bedre, og du hæver barren for dig selv og andre. Du går efter kvalitet og optimerer gerne processerne undervejs.  Du får energi af at udvikle andre og se dem lykkes. Du spotter potentiale og elsker at coache folk til at blive dygtigere.       Dine ansvarsområder vil være:    Drive pipelinen og det opsøgende salg i salgsafdelingen.  Eje vores CRM og bygge de faser og processer, der sætter salget i system.  Lægge planerne og prioritere vores salgsindsatser og sikre, at de bliver ført ud i livet. Altid med øje for, hvad data fortæller dig.  Finde potentialet blandt vores nye såvel som eksisterende kunder og styrke kunderejsen i et intelligent samspil med vores marketing og de retention flows der tiltrækker, vedligeholder og bearbejder leads.  Gå forrest som spillende træner og selv ringe ud til kunder hver uge.  Sætte retning for de samlede salgsindsatser, coache og salgstræne teamet, så sælgerne bliver endnu dygtigere.       Hvad vi forventer af dig:    Du har erfaring med opsøgende salg og ved, hvordan man arbejder videre med kundeporteføljen.  Du er stærk i CRM, gerne på super user-niveau, og har idéer til, hvordan systemet og processerne skal skrues sammen.  Du er kommercielt drevet og forstår hele kunderejsen.  Du sælger ordentligt og troværdigt – du er ikke typen, der oversælger.  Du taler og skriver dansk, engelsk og tysk uden problemer.       Om Zederkof og teamkulturen   I over 25 år har Zederkof leveret professionelle teltløsninger, møbler og inventar til hoteller, restauranter og eventsteder – kort sagt til steder, hvor mennesker mødes. Vi er en ejerledet grossistvirksomhed med base i Fredericia, hvor vi driver vores showroom og webshops. Efter en større digitaliseringstransformation er vi nu klar til at sætte strøm til vores markedsrette

title: Responsable CRM & Fidélisation
description: SCANDALE (anciennement Maison Close) est une maison française de lingerie et de prêt-à-porter qui célèbre l'audace, l'exigence et la créativité. Notre ambition : offrir une expérience digitale premium et innovante à travers nos sites e-commerce, nos marketplaces et l'ensemble de nos points de contact digitaux.     Au sein de l'équipe digitale, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la directrice digitale afin d’accompagner la croissance de la marque grâce aux leviers CRM.       Contexte du poste      Notre activation CRM repose sur l’exploitation de la donnée client centralisée dans un Power BI (branché à Klavyio et Shopify). Nous disposons d'une base riche, dont une base active significative, qu’on doit aujourd’hui piloter stratégiquement pour la transformer en actions concrètes et rentables, cohérentes avec notre image de marque.  Pour cela, nous recherchons un·e CRM Manager pour prendre en main ce pilotage et faire vivre notre programme de fidélité Close to You.      Vos missions       Stratégie CRM & pilotage par la donnée (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Analyser la base client pour identifier les segments à fort potentiel et construire une feuille de route d'actions priorisées par ROI  Définir et suivre les KPI clés : taux de conversion, taux de réactivation, taux de churn, CLTV, coût par contact actif...  Arbitrer les priorités entre acquisition, réactivation et fidélisation en fonction de la rentabilité réelle des actions  Accompagner le.a chargé.e de CRM sur les ciblages des campagnes CRM fonction de la segmentation    Lifecycle marketing (Klaviyo)    Concevoir, déployer et optimiser les flows : bienvenue, post-achat, panier abandonné, winback, programme VIP...  Construire et exécuter des tests A/B pour améliorer en continu la performance des campagnes  Veiller à la cohérence de chaque communication avec l'identité et le ton premium de la marque    Programme de fidélité Close to You (Yotpo)    Piloter et faire évoluer le programme dans son ensemble  :  mécaniques de récompense, paliers, communication dédiée aux membres  Analyser la performance du programme (taux d'adhésion, impact sur la fréquence et la valeur d'achat) et proposer des évolutions  Intégrer pleinement Close to You dans la stratégie CRM globale, comme un levier de rétention à part entière et non un outil isolé  Accompagner la migration du programme sur un nouvel outils (S1 2027)    Reporting & ROI (PowerBI, Klavyio)    Mettre en place un reporting mensuel clair et orienté résultats : CA généré, ROI par campagne, évolution des KPI       Profil recherché    4 à 6 ans d'expérience en CRM / lifecycle marketing / retention, idéalement en environnement DTC e-commerce (mode, beauté, lingerie ou lifestyle premium appréciés)  Maîtrise de Klaviyo (ou équivalent) et bonne aisance avec Shopify  Capacité à lire et exploiter des données Power BI sans dépendre systématiquement d'un·e analyste  Track record démontrable d'actions CRM rentables — CA attribué, taux de conversion, LTV

title: Customer Success Manager - Marché France & Espagne (H/F)
description: Flynt aide les restaurants à piloter leur performance sur les plateformes de livraison (Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat). Nous analysons en continu leurs ventes, leurs promotions et leurs annonces sponsorisées pour leur recommander précisément les bonnes actions, puis mesurer leur impact sur leur rentabilité.  Plus de 2 000 restaurants nous font déjà confiance. Nous construisons le Customer Success de demain : piloté par la donnée, outillé par l’IA et centré sur les décisions qui ont un vrai impact pour nos clients. En rejoignant l’équipe Customer Success, tu occuperas un rôle hybride entre accompagnement client, analyse de la performance et développement commercial, avec un impact direct sur la réussite de nos clients.  Ton périmètre  Selon ton profil, tu piloteras un portefeuille de comptes 100 % France, ou un portefeuille mixte France / Espagne si tu es à l’aise pour travailler au quotidien en espagnol.  Ta mission  Faire de chaque client un restaurateur qui pilote vraiment sa rentabilité et sa visibilité sur les plateformes, en t’appuyant sur la donnée et sur nos outils IA pour aller plus vite et plus loin. Ta mission s’articule autour de 4 axes :   1. Formation & accompagnement     Être l’expert du revenue management pour tes clients et faire en sorte que l’outil Flynt n’ait plus aucun secret pour eux. title: Infrastructure Delivery Manager
description: Christchurch based – with seasonal time as Scott Base  Ownership of asset management and maintenance  Be part of a legacy project in an iconic NZ institution    About the role   Antarctica New Zealand supports world-class science and environmental protection in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean. Scott Base is our home in Antarctica that enables our goals, and we have commenced a four-year project for the redevelopment of the Base.      Antarctica NZ is establishing new roles to meet the demands of the redevelopment. This is one of them. As Manager, Infrastructure Delivery, you’ll lead the operational and delivery arm of Antarctic Infrastructure, turning approved asset plans into safe, reliable maintenance, renewals and capital works. You’ll report to the General Manager, Antarctic Infrastructure.      The challenge    Managing life-critical services, complex engineering, tightly constrained logistics in one of the world’s most hostile environments.  Working with the Base redevelopment team through construction, commissioning and handover.   Helping ensure the new assets are ready to operate, maintain and support science.  Keeping the existing base running safely and reliably.   Embedding new asset planning and management disciplines and new ways of working  Lifting both the technical and the management capability of the team       What you’ll do    Lead four Asset Engineers (Buildings and Services; Water and Wastewater; Energy and Controls; Fleet and Mobile Plant) and the Scott Base Engineering Supervisor  Keep Scott Base’s life support systems maintained and operating to a high standard  Own delivery of planned and reactive maintenance, renewals and the capital works programme within budget and delegated authority  Drive operational health and safety, engineering risk management, statutory compliance and emergency preparedness  Manage contractor and service-delivery performance, and lead engineering assurance and technical governance  Build crew capability, succession and year-round engineering leadership, including winter cover  Travel regularly to Antarctica to lead work on the ice       About you   You’re a high-output leader who raises the bar on both technical standards and team performance. Public or private sector experience is equally relevant, but the expectation is the same; high delivery levels, proven team interaction and challenging the status quo.      Essential experience:    A relevant engineering degree, advanced trade qualification, or demonstrably equivalent senior operational experience  Significant experience leading operational engineering and maintenance teams, ideally in a remote, critical infrastructure or utilities environment  Proven delivery of capital works, renewals and maintenance programmes, including financial control

title: Enhetschef Kund elnät
description: Du söker nya utmaningar och ett meningsfullt arbete som gör skillnad för människor och samhället. Vi letar efter såna som du, som är fulla av engagemang, nyfikenhet och energi. För att leva och bo behöver vi en infrastruktur, förutsättningar för ett fungerande samhälle. Vi är det kommunalägda bolaget som förser Lidköpings kommun med det som kan kallas den osynliga infrastrukturen. Det handlar om vatten och avlopp, bredband och elnät men också om avfallshantering. Elnätet drivs i dotterbolaget Lidköping elnät AB. Våra 120 medarbetare har hög kompetens inom allt från teknik, drift och säkerhet till ekonomi och miljö.      Vårt uppdrag har en betydande roll i kommunens arbete med att forma ett hållbart samhälle och att erbjuda god service till medborgarna. Vi hoppas att du vill vara med på resan att forma just det samhället och att erbjuda den servicen till våra kunder i Lidköping – varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Lidköping miljö och teknik!      Ett ledaruppdrag nära kund och verksamhet   Som Kundchef Elnät får du en central roll i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där kundupplevelse, effektiva processer och regelefterlevnad går hand i hand. Du leder cirka 10 medarbetare inom kundservice, debitering, inköp och lager och ansvarar för kundresan från första kontakt till fakturering.      En viktig del av uppdraget är att utveckla arbetssätt och processer för ökad kvalitet och effektivitet. Du rapporterar till Affärsområdeschef Elnät och ingår i ledningsgruppen tillsammans med cheferna för Drift samt Projekt.       Rollen som Enhetschef Kund elnät   I rollen kommer du bland annat att:   Leda och utveckla ditt team mot ökad effektivitet och kvalitet  Säkerställa regelefterlevnad inom debiteringsprocesser och kundhantering  Ta fram förslag på elnätsavgifter för beslut av styrelsen tillsammans med Affärsområdeschef  Driva införandet av effekttaxa – en ny taxa som börjar gälla 2027  Delta i ledningsgruppen och bidra till elnätsverksamhetens strategiska inriktning och utveckling  Utveckla och dokumentera processer för bättre transparens och kvalitet  Deltaga utveckling av kund- och debiteringssystem för framtida behov och samarbeten  Säkerställa leverans till Billingen Energi  Utvärdera och utveckla samarbetsfördelarna med Billinge Energi       Vem är du?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av kundnära verksamhet, processutveckling, förändringsarbete och av att leda andra. Du kan idag vara chef, teamledare, arbetsledare eller motsvarande roll där du har ett tydligt ansvar för att samordna och utveckla ett team. Vi ser gärna att du har haft personalansvar i någon tidigare roll.      Erfarenhet från elnäts- eller energibranschen är meriterande, men inte ett krav. Viktigare är att du har förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i lagar, regler och marknadsvillkor och omsätta dem i tydliga processer och arbetssätt.     Du har en för området relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, alternativt motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig.

Sammen med et team på fem medarbejdere sikrer du, at vi leverer den aftalte service til vores kunder – med høj kvalitet, godt tempo og sikker eksekvering. Du følger opgaverne helt til dørs, skaber struktur og klare prioriteringer og tager selv aktiv del i opgaverne, når der er behov. Daglig personaleledelse, trivsel, kompetenceudvikling og opfølgning. Herunder prioritering af opgaver, bemanding og ferieplanlægning.  Håndtering og opfølgning på fejl, restordrer og genbestillinger.  Sikre tydelige ansvarsområder, mandater og snitflader internt og ud mod resten af organisationen – herunder bl.a. ansvar for kundedialog om ordrer og leveringer.  Årsaftaler og samarbejde med logistikleverandører  Overordnet ansvar for lagerstyring og varedisponering – herunder balance mellem lagerbinding og servicegrad.  Gennemførsel og videreudvikling af virksomhedens S&OP-proces i samarbejde med salg og øvrige relevante funktioner.  Vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af relevant masterdata i ERP.  Rollen som superbruger og drivkraft for udviklingen af ERP og Power BI.  Bidrage til digitalisering, automatisering og udvikling af ERP og øvrige systemer med udgangspunkt i Operations' behov – herunder anvendelse af AI.  Opbygning af skalerbare processer, der kan understøtte virksomhedens fortsatte vækst       Ledelsesansvar   Du leder teamet gennem tydelige mål, klare prioriteringer og tæt opfølgning. Du skaber fremdrift, sikrer et godt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen og udvikler teamets kompetencer og ansvarlighed. title: Customer Success
description: Om Optiplan   Vi är ett produktbolag som utvecklar SaaS-lösningar för samhällsutveckling inom områden som skolskjuts, skolplacering och turbundna resor.
