Vår ambition är att kombinera affärsnytta med samhällsnytta i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö där alla medarbetare bidrar till både teknisk innovation och samhällsutveckling. Vi erbjuder även konsulttjänster inom verksamhetsutveckling och optimering.  Vi är sedan 2025 en del av Nordtech Group och befinner oss i en fas av stark tillväxt och produktutveckling.  Nu vill vi stärka vårt Customer Success-team med en kollega som vill bidra till att våra kunder får ut mesta möjliga av våra produkter, och som därmed gör nytta för samhället.   Din roll hos oss   Som Customer Success har du en central roll i att våra kunder får en trygg implementering och en god användarupplevelse av våra produkter över tid. Du följer kunden genom hela resan, från implementation till utbildning och support. Du bevakar hur kunderna använder produkten och hittar möjligheter till förbättring, i nära samarbete med produktutveckling och affärsutveckling.  Du blir en del av teamet för Optiplan Elevresor, som optimerar skolskjutsen från elevens lagstadgade rätt till den faktiska resan: lägre kostnader för kommunen, tryggare resor för barnen och färre körda kilometer. Du trivs i gränslandet mellan kund, verksamhet och teknik och värnar om samarbetet både inom CS-teamet och tvärfunktionellt med produktutveckling och sälj.  Som person är du nyfiken och vill förstå varför saker fungerar som de gör, inte bara hur. Struktur är viktigt för dig, och du behåller överblicken även när flera kundprojekt pågår samtidigt. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suoriutumista seurataan selkeiden mittareiden kautta, jotka ohjaavat tekemistä ja tekevät onnistumisen näkyväksi.  Tässä tehtävässä jokainen päivä on erilainen tuoden mukanaan mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja ongelmanratkaisutaitojesi kehittämiseen. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jos nautit vaihtelevasta tekemisestä, pidät langat käsissäsi vauhdikkaassakin arjessa ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja myynnin parissa! Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Tavoitteemme on olla suorittavan työn LinkedIn: globaali verkosto, jossa osaaminen, ihmiset ja työ kohtaavat.     Yrityksille Treamer yhdistää osaajaverkoston, datan ja teknologian nopeampaan rekrytointiin ja sujuvampaan henkilöstönhallintaan. Autamme asiakkaitamme löytämään oikeat tekijät, sitouttamaan osaajia ja vastaamaan muuttuviin henkilöstötarpeisiin kustannustehokkaasti. Kasvamme erityisesti logistiikassa ja teollisuudessa ja etsimme nyt tiimiimme Associate Account Manageria kehittämään näiden alojen asiakkuuksia. Tässä roolissa viet Treamerin ratkaisut osaksi asiakkaiden arkea, autat yhteistyötä kasvamaan ja kehityt samalla kohti itsenäistä asiakkuusvastuuta.      Rooli: Associate Account Manager      Associate Account Managerina työskentelet yhdessä Country Managerin ja Account Managerin kanssa Treamerin merkittävien ja kasvavien logistiikan ja teollisuuden asiakkuuksien parissa.  Tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että yhteistyö asiakkaan kanssa toimii käytännössä ja kehittyy: uudet asiakkaat ja toimipisteet käynnistyvät onnistuneesti, Treamerin palvelut ja työkalut otetaan aktiivisesti käyttöön, henkilöstötarpeet tunnistetaan ajoissa ja sovitut asiat viedään maaliin.     Olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä asiakkaisiin ja opit tuntemaan heidän liiketoimintaansa, toimintaympäristöään ja henkilöstötarpeitaan. Tunnistat myös mahdollisuuksia yhteistyön laajentamiseen ja viet niitä eteenpäin yhdessä Account Managerin kanssa.     Tämä ei ole uusasiakashankintarooli. Saat vastuullesi olemassa olevia sekä myyntitiimin avaamia uusia asiakkuuksia. Roolin tavoitteena on kasvattaa vastuuta kokemuksen karttuessa ja tarjota selkeä polku kohti itsenäistä Account Manager -roolia. Raportoit Country Managerille ja työskentelet päivittäin Account Management-, Customer Success-, Production- ja Support-tiimien kanssa.      Mitä tulet tekemään       Asiakkuudet & kasvu    Työskentelet nimettyjen logistiikan ja teollisuuden asiakkuuksien kanssa yhdessä Account Managerin kanssa.  Olet aktiivisesti yhteydessä asiakkaiden tilaajiin, esihenkilöihin ja muihin sidosryhmiin – puhelimitse, etänä ja kasvokkain.  Osallistut ja vedät asiakkuuksien weekly- ja monthly-palavereita sekä käyt asiakkaiden toimipisteissä.  Onboardaat uusia asiakkaita, toimipisteitä ja käyttäjiä.  Varmistat, että asiakkaan kanssa sovitut toimintamallit, tehtävänimikkeet, palkat, TES-käytännöt, perehdytysmateriaalit ja muut käytännön asiat ovat kunnossa.  Jalk

title: Chef for Sundhedstilbud

description: Vil du spille en central rolle i udviklingen af fremtidens sundhedstilbud hos Danmarks mest innovative sundheds-NGO?      Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens Hjerteforening? Vi søger en Chef for Sundhedstilbud, der kan stå i spidsen for den fortsatte transformation af vores sundhedstilbudsområde og være med til at sætte nye standarder for, hvordan en moderne sundhedsorganisation skaber værdi. Opgaven er at sikre, at flere mennesker oplever relevante tilbud, samtidig med at vi udvikler en mere digital, skalerbar og effektfuld portefølje, der skaber større værdi for flere mennesker.      I Hjerteforeningen arbejder vi på tværs af fagligheder for at skabe størst mulig værdi. Som chef leder du en kompetenceenhed med ansvar for medarbejdernes trivsel, udvikling og faglige styrke. Samtidig driver du en portefølje af tværgående indsatser, hvor medarbejdere fra hele organisationen samarbejder om at løse vores vigtigste opgaver. Du skaber retning, prioriterer ressourcer og sikrer, at de rette kompetencer bringes i spil. Derudover bliver du en del af Hjerteforeningens chefgruppe - Strategisk Forum, hvor du sammen med direktion og chefkollegaer har ansvar for at prioritere indsatser, udviklingsportefølje og ressourcer både på dit eget område og på tværs af organisationen.     Som Chef for Sundhedstilbud bliver du en nøglespiller i at omsætte Hjerteforeningens ambitioner til sundhedstilbud, der gør en mærkbar forskel for danskerne. Du skal gå forrest i at sikre, at vi udvikler nye løsninger, styrker eksisterende tilbud og at flere får gavn af dem gennem blandt andet digitale muligheder. Vi arbejder ud fra princippet test, lær og skaler det der virker med fokus på effekt og værdi. Du skal derfor kunne balancere høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og nærværende ledelse med behovet for at nytænke, konceptualisere, digitalisere og skalere de indsatser, der skaber størst effekt for flest.     Rollen indebærer både personaleledelse i egen kompetenceenhed for pt. 19 medarbejdere og sponsoransvar i tværgående projektteams, der driver og udvikler vores sundhedstilbud. Vi er en ambitiøs og modig organisation, som både skal lykkes med en vigtig sag på den lange bane og samtidig kunne agere hurtigt og ud fra forretningsmæssige logikker. Vi giver stor frihed under ansvar - også til vores medarbejdere - samtidig med at vi er dybt afhængige af, at alle chipper ind i fællesskabet. Vi har derfor brug for en ny chef-kollega, som vil trives godt med både ambitionerne og kulturen, som kan udfordre os og bidrage positivt til, at vi kan sikre hjertesundhed for alle danskere,"  fortæller adm. direktør Morten Ørsted-Rasmussen. description: Haemme palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen alkaen 1.1.2027. Ensimmäisen vuoden jälkeen tehtävä jatkuu toisessa aluekirjaston toimipisteessä, jossa on meneillään rakennus-, remontointi- tai muita laajempia kehittämishankkeita.  Palvelupäällikkönä toimit kirjastonjohtajan työparina. Johdat ja kehität toimintaa valmentavan johtamisen keinoin ja rakennat yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa toimintakulttuuria, jossa ihmiset voivat käyttää osaamistaan, ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää työtään.  Toimit kahden tiimin esihenkilönä, sen lisäksi olet alueen johtotiimin jäsen. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on vahvistaa yhteisöohjautuvuutta ja luoda edellytyksiä sille, että tiimit löytävät yhdessä toimivia ratkaisuja asiakkaiden ja alueen tarpeisiin.  Etsimme kehittämismyönteisiä ja ihmisläheisiä esihenkilöitä, jotka innostuvat muutoksesta ja näkevät mahdollisuuksia myös keskeneräisyydessä. Arvostamme valmentavaa työotetta, hyvä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä viedä asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.  Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva ylempi korkeakoulututkinto.  Valittavalta edellytämme kirjastoalan työkokemusta tai hyvää kirjastopalvelujen ja niiden toimintaympäristön tuntemusta.  Valittavalta edellytämme myös erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa, hyvää englannin kielen suullista taitoa tai erinomaista muun kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.  Eduksi luemme aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen sekä kirjasto- ja informaatioalan opinnot.  Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen tehtävän sekä ison työnantajan työsuhde-edut ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.  Kontulan ja Myllypuron kirjastoihin kuuluu Kontulan palvelukeskuksen kirjasto sekä Aapelinkulma, johon on tulossa uusi yhteisö- ja kulttuuritila. Kontulan ostoskeskukseen suunnitellaan myös uutta kulttuuri- ja vapaa-aika toimialan Kontula-taloa, jonne kirjasto siirtyy. Talon on tarkoitus valmistua ensi vuosikymmenen alussa.  Jos sinua innostaa ajatus, että et johda vain olemassa olevaa, vaan olet rakentamassa sitä, mitä kirjasto voisi tulevaisuudessa olla, tämä tehtävä voi olla sinua varten.  Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan tulevaisuuden kirjastoja Helsinkiin! Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. title: Head of Account Operations in Amazon PPC Agency
description: Our client, a fast-growing international e-commerce company scaling multiple brands on Amazon, is looking for an experienced  Head of Account Operations  to lead its PPC, Account Management, CSM, and Catalogue Coordination functions. This is a senior leadership role with direct ownership of client retention, account health, team performance, and day-to-day operational delivery.  You'll be the primary client-facing CSM and the single point of operational accountability across the account operations function. You'll make sure the right work is being done by the right people, at the right quality, at the right time - while staying close enough to execution to step in when capacity gaps, escalations, or complex account issues require hands-on support. You should be comfortable making decisions independently, managing multiple priorities, developing people, and taking ownership of client outcomes without needing constant CEO involvement.   About the Company:   The company specializes in high-performance Amazon account and advertising management, trusted by clients for its precision, insight, and results. With steady organic growth and a small, expert team, this is a strong opportunity to take ownership of a critical leadership function and help build a highly efficient, scalable account operations department.   Key Responsibilities:    Client & Account Leadership     Serve as the primary client-facing CSM, owning client relationships, satisfaction, retention, and long-term account health.  Lead client calls, set agendas, communicate strategy, manage expectations, and resolve escalations.  Translate client goals, requirements, and SLAs into clear priorities for internal teams.  Proactively identify underperforming accounts, relationship risks, scope creep, and resource-heavy accounts.  Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes and support organic account growth.  Maintain strong strategic alignment between client commercial goals and Amazon PPC / Account Management activity.      Strategic Account Management     Set and adapt PPC and Account Management strategy across the portfolio based on Amazon best practices and client objectives.  Regularly review account performance, strategic direction, and key risks.  Ensure PPC and Account Management teams are working toward clear commercial objectives rather than operating in isolation.  Coordinate Catalogue priorities, listing and variation work, and compliance requirements with PPC, AM, and client needs.  Step into complex account situations and provide senior-level strategic guidance when required. title: Head of Customer Excellence, APAC
description: Who We Are   We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing – and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy – and we know we can’t shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.   What We Do   RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 700+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t rot in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.  We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s accelerating: the first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history, with new contract value up 83% year over year. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.  In response to our fast growth and market expansion we are looking for Head of Customer Excellence for APAC North to lead an integrated Customer Success and Service Delivery team and be accountable for customer outcomes, service health, retention and growth, and the sustainable economics of the regional portfolio.  You will work where customer strategy, service performance and commercial judgement meet. You will help your teams focus on the right customers and interventions, make clear capacity trade-offs, and coordinate action when a risk is bigger than any single CSM or SDM can resolve.  APAC North brings together significant customer opportunity with diverse markets, cultures, languages, partners and service requirements. You will have the mandate to unite those perspectives, build a stronger regional team and make sure customer growth is backed by reliable service, clear accountability and sustainable ways of working.   What We Need You To Do And Be   Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.        Drive customer outcomes and account health: Own portfolio-level outcomes, health, retention and growth, ensuring customers progress through adoption, value realisation and optimisation, working closely with Customer Success Managers and commercial leaders.   Safeguard service health and continuity: Make sure material service risks are visible, clearly owned and progressed with Service Delivery, Support and technical teams. You will act as the main point of contact for assigned clients, helping them get the most value from the company's products and services.  This role goes beyond traditional customer support. You will take ownership of client relationships, drive product adoption, identify potential risks, and work closely with internal teams to improve client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.      Key Responsibilities    Build and maintain strong relationships with a portfolio of restaurant clients.  Take ownership of client accounts and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the post-sales journey.  Coordinate client onboarding and work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience.  Proactively monitor client satisfaction, product adoption, and overall account health.  Understand clients' business goals and challenges, and recommend suitable products and solutions.  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling based on clients' needs.  Identify potential account risks and ensure issues are properly documented, escalated, and resolved.  Collaborate with Sales, Services, and Product teams to deliver a seamless client experience.  Act as the voice of the client by sharing feedback and recommendations with internal teams.  Develop and share best practices to improve client success processes and service quality.       Requirements    Native or near-native fluency in Mandarin Chinese and professional fluency in English, both spoken and written.  Bachelor's degree or higher.  Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts.  Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.  Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.  High sense of ownership, urgency, and initiative.  Ability to build rapport with clients and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.  Willing to work night shifts on-site in Kuala Lumpur.       Nice to Have    2–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or similar client-facing roles, preferably in a high-growth B2B environment.  Previous experience in a startup or entrepreneurial environment.  Experience in the restaurant, hospitality, or consumer services industry.  Strong analytical and data-driven approach to decision-making.  Experience driving customer retention, product adoption, or account growth.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity. title: Technical Account Manager, French speaking
description: About Us   Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.   How We Work   At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values   Bold  in how we dream and innovate   Responsive  to feedback, challenges and opportunities   Accountable  for results and best in class outcomes   Visionary  in future focused problem-solving   Exceptional  in execution and impact  The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a strategic customer advisor and business outcome leader who partners with enterprise customers to drive measurable security value and cyber resiliency. This is a senior, consultative role that operates at the intersection of technology and business strategy—engaging at the CISO and executive level while maintaining the technical depth necessary to guide complex Proofpoint deployments.  The TAM serves as a trusted executive consultant, proactively identifying strategic risks, architecting adoption and value realization plans, and coaching customers on aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security and business frameworks. While the role has evolved to lead with strategic advisory, a strong technical and security software foundation remains essential.  Successful candidates will bring executive presence, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of driving customer outcomes at the enterprise level—combined with deep experience in Linux, messaging, and cloud security environments. Above all, they will have a passion for ensuring a top-quality customer experience.   Your Day-to-Day     Strategic & Advisory (~50%)      Drive business outcomes aligned to customer security and organizational goals, ensuring measurable ROI across the Proofpoint investment.   Serve as a strategic risk advisor—proactively identifying and mitigating renewal, adoption, and security posture risks before they impact the customer.   Act as an executive consultant—building trusted relationships at CISO/VP level, delivering strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.   Architect adoption and value realization plans that ensure customers maximize the full breadth of their Proofpoint deployment.   Coach customers on cyber resiliency strategy—aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security framework and organizational risk tolerance.   Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions, articulating security value in business terms.      Technical & Operational (~50%)      Mainta

title: Service Delivery Manager | Senior
description: Zoek jij als ervaren Service Delivery Manager een plek waar jouw visie op klantrelaties en het continu verbeteren van onze dienstverlening echt het verschil maakt?  Wat ga je doen?  Als Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) ben jij de regisseur van onze dienstverlening en de strategische partner voor onze klanten. Je hoeft zelf geen Azure-architectuur te bouwen of scripts te schrijven, maar je begrijpt de IT-wereld goed genoeg om op niveau mee te praten, de juiste vragen te stellen en de brug te slaan tussen de business van de klant en onze specialisten.  Kopje koffie?   De Klantrelatie     Je tilt de klantbeleving naar een hoger niveau en bouwt aan duurzame, waardevolle relaties;  Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten op operationeel en tactisch niveau;  Je organiseert en leidt de service review meetings en bespreekt de Service Level Rapportages;  Je signaleert commerciële kansen die voortkomen uit klantbehoeften en de dienstverlening.     Sturen Op Kwaliteit En Proces     Je beheert, monitort en optimaliseert de SLA’s, XLA’s, DAP en KPI-resultaten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties;  Je signaleert knelpunten in de dienstverlening en neemt de regie om deze weg te nemen;  Je gaat aan de slag met onze interne processen.     Samenwerken En De Regie Pakken     Je neemt het eigenaarschap over de totale dienstverlening;  Je vertaalt klantvragen en behoeften naar concrete acties voor onze teams binnen Infra & Workplace, Security en Data & AI;  Je zorgt dat de kaders voor iedereen helder zijn, zodat onze specialisten de ruimte krijgen om inhoudelijk te excelleren.     Bouw Mee Aan De Toekomst   Asapcloud is groeiende en dat brengt volop kansen met zich mee. Je krijgt bij ons alle ruimte om actief mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze service delivery. Jouw visie is hierin bepalend. Naarmate we opschalen, groeien jouw mogelijkheden en verantwoordelijkheden vanzelf mee.   Jouw Ontwikkeling & Groei   Bij Asapcloud staat jouw ontwikkeling nooit stil. Onze mensen vormen het fundament van ons succes en daarom investeren we actief in jouw persoonlijke en professionele groei. Ook als ervaren Service Delivery Manager krijg je bij ons alle ruimte om te blijven leren en te vernieuwen.  Via ons ontwikkelprogramma, met een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget en de begeleiding van een interne coach stemmen we jouw groei af op jouw ambities. Of je nu dieper wilt specialiseren in Service Management of wilt doorgroeien naar een bredere leidinggevende functie.

Nachdem wir uns als Marktführer in der Zahnmedizin etabliert haben, gehen wir jetzt den nächsten großen Schritt: neue medizinische Fachbereiche, neue Länder, neue Produkte. title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

title: Senior Associate Information Security Consultant
description:
YOUR JOB

Do you want to rethink information security consulting with AI? Are you excited to automate repetitive work, move faster and spend more time solving real customer challenges? Join us to combine your InfoSec expertise with AI, challenge inefficient ways of working and help shape how AI is used in security consulting.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

  • You use AI to automate repetitive consulting work, accelerate analysis and preparation, and free up more time for high-value customer interaction and problem-solving.

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

title: Account Executive (all genders)
description:
Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter.

Als Account Executive (all genders) bist du ein zentraler Treiber unseres Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, baust Beziehungen zu Entscheidern auf und verantwortest deine Opportunities vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kunden und bestehende Partnerschaften gleichermaßen weiter.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und Deals nicht nur begleiten, sondern selbst gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen.

What to expect

  • Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch eine hochwertige Pipeline auf. Dabei entwickelst du neue Kontakte zu konkreten Opportunities.

  • Understand & qualify: Du führst Discovery-Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und verstehst die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden. So erkennst du, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann, und entwickelst relevante Business Cases.

  • Own the sales cycle (360° Sales): Du verantwortest deine Deals vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Closing. Du hältst überzeugende Präsentationen, koordinierst relevante Stakeholder und sorgst dafür, dass Opportunities konsequent vorankommen.

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersec

description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Marketing

Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs.

Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing.

title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP
description:

title: Growth Associate (Intern) - Ad Monetization
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP, blockchain) and consumer apps.

Role

We're looking for an Ad Monetization Analyst Intern to support ad revenue optimization and growth strategies across a portfolio of mobile games & apps. Reporting to the Monetization Lead, you will use your analytical mindset, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills to help maximize performance and turn strong products into top-performing titles.

  • Manage and optimize ad monetization and performance marketing strategies across multiple networks and platforms.

  • Analyze key metrics and A/B tests to maximize ad performance, user LTV, and overall ROI.

  • Provide data-driven insights to enhance growth, monetization, and product decisions.

  • Collaborate with product, tech, and data teams on SDK integrations, dashboards, and automation tools.

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.

  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

description:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About the Role:

Headway is already the largest mental health network for America's leading health plans. Very few marketing leaders get to operate at a scale where their work materially shapes how mental health care works in America. This is that role.

We're looking for a Director of Payer Marketing to build and lead the function that makes Headway the most credible, trusted voice in the room whenever a payer talks about mental health. This is an enterprise B2B product marketing leader at heart — someone who translates narrative to commercial leverage, knows their audience backwards and forwards, and understands how that work builds towards outcomes: deeper relationships, stronger renewals, expanded partnerships, and better terms.

This is a player-coach role for someone who is a builder at heart. You'll set the payer-marketing strategy, build and lead a small, high-caliber team, and work hand-in-hand with our Payer/Commercial, Clinical Strategy, and Provider, Patient & Brand marketing teams.

What you'll own:

  • Set the payer marketing strategy. Define the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM plan for Headway with health plans. The payer story is never just a payer story; it's the synthesis of everything Headway is doing across the platform.

  • Build the function from zero. This isn't a role where you inherit a playbook — you'll define the operating model, the team structure, the cadences, and the metrics that make payer marketing a true commercial lever. You'll create milestones without being handed a roadmap and build momentum in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

  • Build the category story everyone wants to be part of.

title: Senior Stock Administrator
description:

  Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does:  play video games.  Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.   Discord is where hundreds of millions of people come together around games, communities, and shared interests. Behind the scenes, our Stock Administration team makes sure every equity award — from a new hire's first grant to a multi-year vesting RSU release — is handled accurately, compliantly, and with care. 
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Stock Plan Administrator to join our team supporting the day-to-day administration of Discord's global equity programs, including equity grants, option exercises, RSU releases, and special projects. On any given day, you might be supporting the administration of equity grants, walking an employee through their vesting schedule, or partnering with our auditors to test a SOX control. You will partner with key stakeholders in our Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and HR teams to answer employee inquiries, educate employees on equity programs, improve processes, implement controls, and provide reporting as needed. You will also work directly with external auditors and third-party vendors. This position will report directly to the Senior Manager, Stock Administration. 
  What you'll be doing:  
 
 Manage the daily administration of Discord's global equity plans — from participant eligibility and enrollment through award processing, exercises, settlements, tax withholding, mobility reporting, expirations, cancellations, repurchases, and terminations. 
 Process, validate, and reconcile equity transactions across equity administration platforms, payroll, and the general ledger, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and timely resolution of discrepancies. 
 Partner with Legal, HR, Payroll, Tax, and Finance to administer Discord's global equity programs and support ongoing processes that ensure accurate record-keeping, withholding, reporting, and reconciliation across all equity data. 
 Maintain complete and reliable participant mobility data by tracking work locations and mobility history, and reconciling records across payroll and HRIS systems. 
 Provide a high level of service to employees, management, and stakeholders on equity plan questions; design and deliver educational sessions and communications about Discord's equity programs. 
 Manage the quarterly calendar of stock administration activities and prepare year-end tax information for IRC 6039 reporting. 
 Ensure SOX compliance across all aspects of the equity plan — including documentation, testing, and audit support — and ensure all equity compensation is administered per plan terms and conditions.

Als Customer Success Manager ben je de schakel tussen onze klanten en onze online marketeers. Je zorgt ervoor dat klanten tevreden zijn, we resultaten behalen en alle kansen benutten. Je bent niet alleen een aanspreekpunt, maar ook een strategische sparringpartner die meedenkt over groei.     Je komt terecht in een team waar samenwerking centraal staat. We helpen elkaar, delen kennis en vieren successen samen.      Wat ga je doen?   Geen dag is hetzelfde, maar je houdt je onder andere bezig met:   Het onderhouden van klantrelaties en het voeren van strategische gesprekken. Het analyseren van resultaten en het bespreken van verbeterkansen.  Het signaleren van commerciële kansen en groeimogelijkheden.      Je werkt dagelijks samen met collega's uit SEO, Google Ads en content om ervoor te zorgen dat klanten de resultaten behalen die we samen nastreven.      Wie zoeken wij?     Je hoeft niet alles al te kunnen.   We vinden het belangrijker dat je goed kunt communiceren, relaties kunt opbouwen en energie krijgt van klantcontact.     Herken jij jezelf hierin?   Je hebt ervaring in Customer Success, accountmanagement, relatiebeheer of een vergelijkbare rol.  Je vindt het leuk om klanten verder te helpen.  Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende klanten en projecten.  Je communiceert makkelijk met zowel klanten als collega's.  Je denkt in oplossingen en kansen.  Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen.   Heb je nog geen uitgebreide ervaring binnen online marketing, maar wel ervaring met klantmanagement? Geen probleem, wij leren je graag de rest!      Waarom werken bij iClicks?   Bij iClicks krijg je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:   Een salaris tot € 4.150,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Een goede pensioenregeling.  25 vakantiedagen op basis van een werkweek van 40 uur. description:
Headquarters:  Remote
 

 Alloy is where you belong! 
 Alloy is the AI-powered identity and fraud prevention platform that accelerates onboarding, stops fraud, and scales compliance across the customer lifecycle so financial organizations can grow without limits. More than 900 of the world's leading financial institutions and fintechs trust Alloy for smarter risk management that drives growth.

Through our values: Be Bold, Go Fast, Collaborate, and Celebrate Our Differences, we are creating a workplace where you can grow, thrive, and belong. See how we’ve been continuously recognized and named one of  Inc.Magazine’s Best Workplaces ,  Forbes America’s Best Startup Employers ,  Best Fintech to Work for by American Banker , year after year.

Check out our investors and read more about us  here .

You’ll be leveraging your technical skills, problem-solving instincts, written communication, and verbal skills to clarify customer issues and build trust with professionalism and empathy.

title: AI Security Sales Executive, North Central
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - USA
 

  ABOUT THE ROLE  
 AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market. 
 The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. 
 The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold. 
  WHAT YOU'LL DO  
 
 Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close. 
 Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation. 
 Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume. 
 Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most. 
 Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch. 
 Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table. 
 Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA. 
 Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing. 
 Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace. 
 
  WHAT YOU'LL SELL  
 Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability: 
 
 AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost. 
 AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

About the Role

  • Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement.

Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.

description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences.
